",
  "모터가 정지되었습니다.":"",
  "착륙했습니다. 모터가 회전 중입니다.":"",
  "조종기 입력 연결이 끊겼습니다.":"",
  "홈 포인트가 갱신되었습니다.":""
};
const flightVoiceBuffers=new Map();
const flightVoiceQueue=[];
let flightVoiceContext=null;
let flightVoiceSource=null;
let flightVoiceEnabled=false;
let flightVoiceSequence=0;
let flightVoiceDecoding=false;

const flightVoiceButtons=[$('flightVoiceToggle'),$('flightVoiceDialogToggle')];

function setFlightVoiceState(enabled, message) {
  flightVoiceEnabled=enabled;
  for (const button of flightVoiceButtons) {
    button.textContent=enabled?'음성 활성화':'음성 비활성화';
    button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(enabled));
    button.title=message||(enabled?'한국어 비행 안내 비활성화':'한국어 비행 안내 활성화');
  }
  $('flightVoiceStatus').value=message||(enabled?'한국어 음성 활성화':'한국어 음성 비활성화');
}

function stopFlightVoice() {
  flightVoiceSequence++;
  flightVoiceQueue.length=0;
  flightVoiceDecoding=false;
  if (!flightVoiceSource) return;
  flightVoiceSource.onended=null;
  flightVoiceSource.stop();
  flightVoiceSource.disconnect();
  flightVoiceSource=null;
}

async function playNextFlightVoice() {
  if (!flightVoiceEnabled||flightVoiceContext.state!=='running'||flightVoiceSource||flightVoiceDecoding||!flightVoiceQueue.length) return;
  const message=flightVoiceQueue.shift(), sequence=flightVoiceSequence;
  flightVoiceDecoding=true;
  try {
    let buffer=flightVoiceBuffers.get(message);
    if (!buffer) {
      const mp3=Uint8Array.from(atob(flightVoiceClips[message]),character=>character.charCodeAt(0));
      buffer=await flightVoiceContext.decodeAudioData(mp3.buffer);
      flightVoiceBuffers.set(message,buffer);
    }
    if (sequence!==flightVoiceSequence) return;
    flightVoiceDecoding=false;
    const source=flightVoiceContext.createBufferSource();
    source.buffer=buffer;
    source.connect(flightVoiceContext.destination);
    source.onended=()=>{
      source.disconnect();
      if (flightVoiceSource===source) {
        flightVoiceSource=null;
        playNextFlightVoice();
      }
    };
    source.start();
    flightVoiceSource=source;
  } catch {
    if (sequence!==flightVoiceSequence) return;
    stopFlightVoice();
    setFlightVoiceState(false,'한국어 음성 재생 실패 · 음성 버튼을 다시 누르세요');
  }
}

function announceFlight(text,{interrupt=false}={}) {
  if (!flightVoiceEnabled||!Object.hasOwn(flightVoiceClips,text)) return;
  if (interrupt) stopFlightVoice();
  if (flightVoiceQueue.length>=3) flightVoiceQueue.shift();
  flightVoiceQueue.push(text);
  playNextFlightVoice();
}

function setupFlightVoice() {
  const AudioEngine=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;
  if (!AudioEngine) {
    flightVoiceButtons.forEach(button=>{button.disabled=true;});
    setFlightVoiceState(false,'이 브라우저에서 음성을 재생할 수 없습니다');
    return;
  }
  const toggleVoice=async()=>{
    if (flightVoiceEnabled) {
      stopFlightVoice();
      setFlightVoiceState(false);
      return;
    }
    flightVoiceButtons.forEach(button=>{button.disabled=true;});
    let timeout;
    try {
      flightVoiceContext??=new AudioEngine();
      flightVoiceContext.onstatechange=()=>{
        if (flightVoiceEnabled&&flightVoiceContext.state!=='running') {
          stopFlightVoice();
          setFlightVoiceState(false,'음성 재생 중단 · 음성 버튼을 눌러 다시 활성화하세요');
        }
      };
      await Promise.race([flightVoiceContext.resume(),new Promise((_,reject)=>{
        timeout=setTimeout(()=>reject(new Error('audio timeout')),3500);
      })]);
      if (flightVoiceContext.state!=='running') throw new Error('audio suspended');
      setFlightVoiceState(true);
      announceFlight('한국어 음성 안내가 활성화되었습니다.');
    } catch {
      setFlightVoiceState(false,'음성을 시작할 수 없습니다 · Chrome, Edge 또는 Safari에서 직접 열어주세요');
    } finally {
      clearTimeout(timeout);
      flightVoiceButtons.forEach(button=>{button.disabled=false;});
    }
  };
  flightVoiceButtons.forEach(button=>{button.onclick=toggleVoice;});
}

const degrees = Math.PI / 180;
const clamp = (n, min, max) => Math.min(max, Math.max(min, n));
const selectedIndex = () => activeCamera === 'ir' ? 1 : 0;
const linked = () => $('lock').checked;
const isVisible = i => !(i ? $('irWrap') : $('eoWrap')).hidden;
function isUnavailableSatelliteImage(data) {
  if (data.byteLength!==2521) return false;
  // Esri serves this particular placeholder as a successful JPEG; identify the verified response bytes.
  let hash=2166136261;
  for (const byte of new Uint8Array(data)) hash=Math.imul(hash^byte,16777619);
  return (hash>>>0)===0x92d9118f;
}

const cameraDemMaxZoom = 13;
const cameraImageryMaxZoom = 19;
const cameraDemScheme = 'tsd-elevation://tiles/';
const cameraDemTiles = cameraDemScheme+'{z}/{x}/{y}';
const terrainTileLoads = new Map();
const terrainTileCache = new Map();
const terrainTileCacheLimit = tsdLowPower ? 48 : 112;
const flightTileLookahead = { lastAt:-Infinity, active:0 };
const terrainDetailViews = new WeakMap();
// Rev14e: restore the established display processing; observe rather than reshape
// neighbouring DEM edges. Keep diagnostics bounded and opt-in on normal-power PCs.
const terrainAuditEnabled=!tsdLowPower && tsdPerfParams.get('tsdTerrainDebug')==='1';
const terrainAudit={decoded:0,rejected:0,parentFailures:0,repaired:0,missingImagery:0,edgePairs:0,edgeMax:0,edgeMeanMax:0};
const terrainAuditEdges=new Map();

function rememberTerrainTile(url, tile) {
  const cacheControl=tile.cacheControl || '';
  if (/\b(?:no-store|no-cache)\b/i.test(cacheControl)) return;
  const lifetime=Number(cacheControl.match(/\bmax-age=(\d+)/i)?.[1]??120);
  if(!lifetime)return;
  const expires=Date.parse(tile.expires||'');
  const ttl=Math.min(lifetime*1000,120000,Number.isFinite(expires)?expires-Date.now():Infinity);
  if(ttl<=0)return;
  terrainTileCache.set(url,{tile,until:Date.now()+ttl});
  if(terrainTileCache.size>terrainTileCacheLimit)terrainTileCache.delete(terrainTileCache.keys().next().value);
}

function demElevation(pixels, offset) {
  return pixels[offset]*256+pixels[offset+1]+pixels[offset+2]/256-32768;
}

function validateDisplayDem(pixels) {
  if(pixels.width!==256||pixels.height!==256||pixels.data.length!==256*256*4)return false;
  for(let i=3;i<pixels.data.length;i+=4)if(pixels.data[i]!==255)return false;
  return true;
}

function observeTerrainEdges(pixels,z,x,y) {
  if(!terrainAuditEnabled)return;
  const n=pixels.width,m=pixels.height,d=pixels.data;
  const edges={top:new Float32Array(n),bottom:new Float32Array(n),left:new Float32Array(m),right:new Float32Array(m)};
  for(let i=0;i<n;i++){edges.top[i]=demElevation(d,i*4);edges.bottom[i]=demElevation(d,((m-1)*n+i)*4);}
  for(let i=0;i<m;i++){edges.left[i]=demElevation(d,i*n*4);edges.right[i]=demElevation(d,(i*n+n-1)*4);}
  const key=(a,b)=>`${z}/${a}/${b}`;
  if(terrainAuditEdges.has(key(x,y)))return;
  for(const [dx,dy,side,opposite] of [[-1,0,'left','right'],[1,0,'right','left'],[0,-1,'top','bottom'],[0,1,'bottom','top']]){
    const other=terrainAuditEdges.get(key(x+dx,y+dy));if(!other)continue;
    const first=edges[side],second=other[opposite];let sum=0,max=0;
    for(let i=0;i<first.length;i++){const delta=Math.abs(first[i]-second[i]);sum+=delta;max=Math.max(max,delta);}
    terrainAudit.edgePairs++;terrainAudit.edgeMax=Math.max(terrainAudit.edgeMax,max);
    terrainAudit.edgeMeanMax=Math.max(terrainAudit.edgeMeanMax,sum/first.length);
  }
  terrainAuditEdges.set(key(x,y),edges);
  if(terrainAuditEdges.size>96)terrainAuditEdges.delete(terrainAuditEdges.keys().next().value);
}

function suspectDemSamples(pixels, width, height) {
  const suspect=[];
  for(let y=0;y<height;y++){
    for(let x=0;x<width;x++){
      const offset=(y*width+x)*4;
      const h=demElevation(pixels,offset);
      if(h < -45 || h > 9000){suspect.push({x,y,h,offset});continue;}
      if(x===0||y===0||x===width-1||y===height-1)continue;
      const ns=(demElevation(pixels,offset-width*4)+demElevation(pixels,offset+width*4))/2;
      const ew=(demElevation(pixels,offset-4)+demElevation(pixels,offset+4))/2;
      // Both opposite neighbour pairs must agree that the centre is a spike.
      if((h-ns>18 && h-ew>18)||(ns-h>18 && ew-h>18))suspect.push({x,y,h,offset});
    }
  }
  return suspect;
}

function sampleParentDem(parent, childX, childY, x, y, width, height) {
  const px=clamp(((childX%2)+(x+.5)/width)*parent.width/2-.5,0,parent.width-1);
  const py=clamp(((childY%2)+(y+.5)/height)*parent.height/2-.5,0,parent.height-1);
  const left=Math.floor(px),top=Math.floor(py),right=Math.min(parent.width-1,left+1),bottom=Math.min(parent.height-1,top+1);
  const fx=px-left,fy=py-top;
  const at=(col,row)=>demElevation(parent.data,(row*parent.width+col)*4);
  return (at(left,top)*(1-fx)+at(right,top)*fx)*(1-fy)+(at(left,bottom)*(1-fx)+at(right,bottom)*fx)*fy;
}

function restoreDemSamples(child, suspect, parent, childX, childY) {
  let changes=0;
  for(const {x,y,h,offset} of suspect){
    const reference=sampleParentDem(parent,childX,childY,x,y,child.width,child.height);
    // Similar sharp relief in the parent is evidence to preserve the finer measurement.
    if(h<=9000 && Math.abs(reference-h)<(h < -45 ? 20 : 26))continue;
    const value=Math.round((reference+32768)*256);
    child.data[offset]=(value>>>16)&255;
    child.data[offset+1]=(value>>>8)&255;
    child.data[offset+2]=value&255;
    changes++;
  }
  return changes;
}

async function decodeCameraDem(data) {
  const bitmap=await createImageBitmap(new Blob([data],{type:'image/png'}),{colorSpaceConversion:'none',premultiplyAlpha:'none'});
  try {
    const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width=bitmap.width;
    canvas.height=bitmap.height;
    const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
    if(!ctx)throw new Error('DEM 디코더 초기화 실패');
    ctx.drawImage(bitmap,0,0);
    return {canvas,ctx,pixels:ctx.getImageData(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height)};
  } finally { bitmap.close(); }
}

function smoothDisplayHeights(pixels, radius) {
  const {width,height,data}=pixels;
  const horizontal=new Float32Array(width*height);
  const span=2*radius+1;
  for(let y=0;y<height;y++){
    let sum=0;
    for(let dx=-radius;dx<=radius;dx++)sum+=demElevation(data,(y*width+clamp(dx,0,width-1))*4);
    for(let x=0;x<width;x++){
      horizontal[y*width+x]=sum/span;
      const entering=clamp(x+radius+1,0,width-1), leaving=clamp(x-radius,0,width-1);
      sum+=demElevation(data,(y*width+entering)*4)-demElevation(data,(y*width+leaving)*4);
    }
  }
  const surface=new Float32Array(width*height);
  for(let x=0;x<width;x++){
    let sum=0;
    for(let dy=-radius;dy<=radius;dy++)sum+=horizontal[clamp(dy,0,height-1)*width+x];
    for(let y=0;y<height;y++){
      surface[y*width+x]=sum/span;
      sum+=horizontal[clamp(y+radius+1,0,height-1)*width+x]-horizontal[clamp(y-radius,0,height-1)*width+x];
    }
  }
  return surface;
}

function stabilizeDisplayHeights(tile, level, parent, column, row) {
  const radius=level>=13?6:level===12?3:2;
  const {width,height,data}=tile;
  const surface=smoothDisplayHeights(tile,radius);
  for(let y=0;y<height;y++){
    for(let x=0;x<width;x++){
      const index=y*width+x, offset=index*4;
      const smooth=surface[index];
      const detail=demElevation(data,offset)-smooth;
      let corrected=smooth+clamp(detail,-6,6)*.28;
      if(parent){
        const base=sampleParentDem(parent,column,row,x,y,width,height);
        const edge=Math.min(x,y,width-1-x,height-1-y);
        const blend=clamp(edge/(radius+2),0,1);
        // Connect differently detailed terrain tiles to the same parent along their edges.
        corrected=base+clamp(corrected-base,-16,16)*blend;
      }
      const value=Math.round((corrected+32768)*256);
      data[offset]=(value>>>16)&255;
      data[offset+1]=(value>>>8)&255;
      data[offset+2]=value&255;
    }
  }
}

let terrainSurfaceWorker;
let terrainSurfaceJob = 0;
const terrainSurfaceJobs = new Map();

function getTerrainSurfaceWorker() {
  if(terrainSurfaceWorker!==undefined)return terrainSurfaceWorker;
  terrainSurfaceWorker=null;
  if(typeof Worker!=='function')return terrainSurfaceWorker;
  const processor=[demElevation,sampleParentDem,smoothDisplayHeights,stabilizeDisplayHeights]
    .map(fn=>fn.toString()).join('\n');
  const source=`'use strict';
const clamp=${clamp.toString()};
${processor}
self.onmessage=event=>{
  const {id,pixels,level,parent,column,row}=event.data;
  stabilizeDisplayHeights(pixels,level,parent,column,row);
  self.postMessage({id,data:pixels.data},[pixels.data.buffer]);
};`;
  const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([source],{type:'text/javascript'}));
  try {
    const worker=new Worker(url);
    worker.onmessage=({data})=>terrainSurfaceJobs.get(data.id)?.finish(data.data);
    worker.onerror=()=>{
      worker.terminate();
      terrainSurfaceWorker=null;
      for(const job of terrainSurfaceJobs.values())job.finish(null);
    };
    terrainSurfaceWorker=worker;
  } catch {}
  finally {URL.revokeObjectURL(url);}
  return terrainSurfaceWorker;
}

async function processDisplayHeights(pixels,level,parent,column,row) {
  const worker=getTerrainSurfaceWorker();
  if(worker){
    const data=await new Promise(resolve=>{
      const id=++terrainSurfaceJob;
      const finish=result=>{
        clearTimeout(timer);
        terrainSurfaceJobs.delete(id);
        resolve(result);
      };
      const timer=setTimeout(()=>finish(null),2500);
      terrainSurfaceJobs.set(id,{finish});
      try {worker.postMessage({id,pixels,level,parent,column,row});}
      catch {finish(null);}
    });
    if(data){pixels.data.set(data);return;}
  }
  stabilizeDisplayHeights(pixels,level,parent,column,row);
}

function cameraElevationUrl(z,x,y) {
  return DEM.replace('{z}',z).replace('{x}',x).replace('{y}',y);
}

async function correctCameraDem(data,url,signal) {
  const coordinates=/\/(\d+)\/(\d+)\/(\d+)\.png$/.exec(url);
  if(!coordinates||Number(coordinates[1])<11||typeof createImageBitmap!=='function')return data;
  const [,level,column,row]=coordinates.map(Number);
  const child=await decodeCameraDem(data);
  const pixels=child.pixels;
  // An opaque 256px Terrarium tile is required by the declared raster-dem source.
  // Do not let transparent or mismatched images silently decode as negative heights.
  if(!tsdLowPower){
    if(!validateDisplayDem(pixels)){terrainAudit.rejected++;throw Object.assign(new Error('DEM 타일 크기 또는 알파 오류'),{status:404});}
    terrainAudit.decoded++;
  }
  const suspect=suspectDemSamples(pixels.data,pixels.width,pixels.height);
  let parent=null;
  if(level>=12||suspect.length){
    const parentUrl=cameraElevationUrl(level-1,Math.floor(column/2),Math.floor(row/2));
    try {
      const source=await readTerrainTile(parentUrl,false,{signal});
      parent=(await decodeCameraDem(source.data)).pixels;
      if(!tsdLowPower&&!validateDisplayDem(parent)){
        parent=null;
        throw new Error('상위 DEM 타일 형식 오류');
      }
    } catch(error) {
      if(signal.aborted)throw error;
      if(!tsdLowPower)terrainAudit.parentFailures++;
      if(suspect.length)throw Object.assign(new Error('고도 타일 상위 데이터 확인 실패'),{status:404,cause:error});
    }
  }
  if(parent&&suspect.length){const repaired=restoreDemSamples(pixels,suspect,parent,column,row);if(!tsdLowPower)terrainAudit.repaired+=repaired;}
  await processDisplayHeights(pixels,level,parent,column,row);
  observeTerrainEdges(pixels,level,column,row);
  child.ctx.putImageData(pixels,0,0);
  const image=await new Promise(resolve=>child.canvas.toBlob(resolve,'image/png'));
  if(!image)throw Object.assign(new Error('고도 타일 인코딩 실패'),{status:404});
  return image.arrayBuffer();
}

async function downloadTerrainTile(url, imagery, headers, signal) {
  const requestUrl=imagery&&!tsdLowPower?url+(url.includes('?')?'&':'?')+'blankTile=false':url;
  const response=await fetch(requestUrl,{signal,headers});
  if(!response.ok){if(imagery&&response.status===404)terrainAudit.missingImagery++;throw Object.assign(new Error('지형 타일 응답 '+response.status),{status:response.status});}
  const data=await response.arrayBuffer();
  if(imagery&&(response.headers.get('blank-tile')==='true'||isUnavailableSatelliteImage(data))){
    terrainAudit.missingImagery++;
    throw Object.assign(new Error('위성 타일 없음'),{status:404});
  }
  const safeData=imagery?data:await correctCameraDem(data,url,signal);
  return {data:safeData,cacheControl:response.headers.get('cache-control')||undefined,expires:response.headers.get('expires')||undefined};
}

function readTerrainTile(url, imagery, {signal,headers}={}) {
  if(signal?.aborted)return Promise.reject(signal.reason);
  const cached=terrainTileCache.get(url);
  if(cached?.tile&&cached.until>Date.now())return Promise.resolve(cached.tile);
  if(cached)terrainTileCache.delete(url);
  let task=terrainTileLoads.get(url);
  if(!task){
    const controller=new AbortController();
    const timeout=setTimeout(()=>controller.abort(),8000);
    task={controller,waiters:0,done:false};
    terrainTileLoads.set(url,task);
    task.promise=downloadTerrainTile(url,imagery,headers,controller.signal).then(tile=>{
      rememberTerrainTile(url,tile);
      return tile;
    }).finally(()=>{
      clearTimeout(timeout);
      task.done=true;
      if(terrainTileLoads.get(url)===task)terrainTileLoads.delete(url);
    });
  }
  task.waiters++;
  const source = !signal ? task.promise : new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{
    const abort=()=>reject(signal.reason);
    signal.addEventListener('abort',abort,{once:true});
    const finish=callback=>value=>{signal.removeEventListener('abort',abort);callback(value);};
    task.promise.then(finish(resolve),finish(reject));
  });
  return source.finally(()=>{
    task.waiters--;
    if (!task.waiters && !task.done) {
      if(terrainTileLoads.get(url)===task)terrainTileLoads.delete(url);
      task.controller.abort();
    }
  });
}

function terrainTileCoordinates(point,z) {
  const {x,y}=maplibregl.MercatorCoordinate.fromLngLat(point);
  const n=2**z;
  return {z,x:((Math.floor(x*n)%n)+n)%n,y:clamp(Math.floor(y*n),0,n-1)};
}

function cameraHeightOverGround(map,eye) {
  const localGround=tsdVisibleSurface(map,eye);
  const ground=localGround ?? (!map.getCenterClampedToGround() && flight.point && !directBrowseView
    ? flight.ground : map.getCenterElevation());
  return Number.isFinite(ground) ? Math.max(12,eye.alt-ground) : null;
}

function updateTerrainDetailView(map) {
  if(tsdLowPower){
    const now=performance.now();
    if(now-(tsdPerformance.lastTerrainAt.get(map)||-Infinity)<320)return;
    tsdPerformance.lastTerrainAt.set(map,now);
  }
  const eye=cameraOrigin(map);
  const {lng,lat,alt}=eye;
  const width=map.transform.width, height=map.transform.height;
  if(!(width>0 && height>0) || ![lng,lat,alt].every(Number.isFinite)){
    terrainDetailViews.delete(map);
    return;
  }
  const agl=cameraHeightOverGround(map,eye);
  if(agl==null){terrainDetailViews.delete(map);return;}
  const drawingRatio=clamp(map.getCanvas().height/height,1,1.6);
  const density=Math.min(drawingRatio,Math.sqrt(2_000_000/(width*height)));
  terrainDetailViews.set(map,{
    agl,pixels:height*density,metre:maplibregl.MercatorCoordinate.fromLngLat(eye).meterInMercatorCoordinateUnits()
  });
}

function cameraTileTargetZoom(view, groundDistance, fov) {
  const focal=view.pixels/(2*Math.tan(fov*degrees/2));
  const range=Math.hypot(groundDistance,view.agl*view.metre);
  return Math.min(cameraImageryMaxZoom,Math.log2(focal/(256*range))+.45);
}

function refineCameraTileZoom(view, source, zoom, baseline, groundDistance, fov) {
  const nearLimit=clamp(view.agl*2.6,180,920);
  const groundMeters=groundDistance/view.metre;
  const weight=clamp((nearLimit*1.75-groundMeters)/(nearLimit*.75),0,1);
  if(weight===0)return baseline;
  const imageryZoom=cameraTileTargetZoom(view,groundDistance,fov);
  // Keep the geometry texture grid close to the imagery grid so the GPU does not pack
  // a large number of sharp imagery tiles back into a single distant terrain texture.
  const projected=source==='dem'?imageryZoom-1:imageryZoom;
  return baseline+Math.max(0,Math.min(projected,zoom+3)-baseline)*weight;
}

function flightTileCandidates(position, course, speed, detail, fov) {
  const angle=course*degrees;
  const advance=metres=>offsetPoint(position,Math.sin(angle)*metres,Math.cos(angle)*metres);
  const short=clamp(speed*5,45,110), far=clamp(speed*12,100,255);
  const points=[advance(short),advance(far),position];
  const imageZoom=clamp(Math.round(cameraTileTargetZoom(detail,short*detail.metre,fov)),16,cameraImageryMaxZoom);
  const candidates=[];
  for(const point of points){
    const image=terrainTileCoordinates(point,imageZoom);
    const dem=terrainTileCoordinates(point,cameraDemMaxZoom);
    candidates.push({url:satelliteTileService+`${image.z}/${image.y}/${image.x}`,imagery:true},
      {url:cameraElevationUrl(dem.z,dem.x,dem.y),imagery:false});
  }
  return candidates;
}

function prefetchFlightTerrain(now) {
  if(document.hidden||now-flightTileLookahead.lastAt<(tsdLowPower?1400:450)||!flight.point||flight.speed<.6)return;
  flightTileLookahead.lastAt=now;
  const map=maps[selectedIndex()], detail=terrainDetailViews.get(map);
  if(!detail||!map.getSource('imagery')||!Number.isFinite(flight.course)||!Number.isFinite(flight.speed))return;
  for(const candidate of flightTileCandidates(flight.point,flight.course,flight.speed,detail,map.getVerticalFieldOfView())){
    if(flightTileLookahead.active>=(tsdLowPower?1:2))break;
    if(terrainTileLoads.has(candidate.url)||terrainTileCache.get(candidate.url)?.until>Date.now())continue;
    flightTileLookahead.active++;
    // A missing/high-load tile should leave the parent visible and avoid repeated speculative traffic.
    void readTerrainTile(candidate.url,candidate.imagery).catch(()=>{
      if(!terrainTileCache.has(candidate.url)) {
        terrainTileCache.set(candidate.url,{until:Date.now()+5000});
        if(terrainTileCache.size>terrainTileCacheLimit)terrainTileCache.delete(terrainTileCache.keys().next().value);
      }
    }).finally(()=>{flightTileLookahead.active--;});
  }
}

async function loadSatelliteTile(request, abortController) {
  const url=satelliteTileService+request.url.slice(satelliteTileProtocol.length);
  const tile=await readTerrainTile(url,true,{signal:abortController.signal,headers:request.headers});
  // MapLibre can transfer the buffer to a worker. Keep the shared copy intact.
  return {...tile,data:tile.data.slice(0)};
}

async function loadCameraElevationTile(request, abortController) {
  const [z,x,y]=request.url.slice(cameraDemScheme.length).split('/');
  const url=cameraElevationUrl(z,x,y);
  const tile=await readTerrainTile(url,false,{signal:abortController.signal,headers:request.headers});
  return {...tile,data:tile.data.slice(0)};
}

function mapStyle({cameraView=false}={}) {
  if ($('base').value === 'street') return 'https://tiles.openfreemap.org/styles/liberty';
  const imagery={type:'raster',tiles:[SAT],tileSize:256,maxzoom:cameraImageryMaxZoom,attribution:'Tiles © Esri and its imagery providers'};
  const style={
    version:8,
    sources:{imagery},
    layers:[{id:'imagery',type:'raster',source:'imagery',paint:{'raster-resampling':'linear','raster-fade-duration':140}}]
  };
  if (cameraView && !tsdLowPower) {
    // Keep coarse satellite imagery underneath detailed tiles during camera movement on full-power devices.
    style.sources['imagery-overview']={...imagery,maxzoom:12};
    style.layers.unshift({id:'imagery-overview',type:'raster',source:'imagery-overview',minzoom:11,
      paint:{'raster-resampling':'linear','raster-fade-duration':0}});
  }
  return style;
}

function configureCameraTileDetail(map) {
  if(tsdLowPower){
    map.setSourceTileLodParams(8.5,3.0);
    if(map.getSource('imagery'))map.setSourceTileLodParams(8,3.3,'imagery');
    return;
  }
  map.setSourceTileLodParams(10, 2.8);
  const imagery=map.getSource('imagery');
  const normalImageryLod=imagery?.calculateTileZoom;
  if(imagery)map.setSourceTileLodParams(8.5, 5.2, 'imagery');
  for(const id of Object.keys(map.getStyle().sources)){
    const source=map.getSource(id);
    const calculate=source.calculateTileZoom;
    source.calculateTileZoom=(zoom,groundDistance,verticalDistance,centerDistance,fov)=>{
      if(!(centerDistance>0))return zoom;
      const safeHeight=clamp(verticalDistance,centerDistance*.0087,centerDistance);
      const lod=calculate(zoom,groundDistance,safeHeight,centerDistance,fov);
      let baseline=Number.isFinite(lod)?lod:zoom;
      const distanceRatio=Math.hypot(groundDistance,safeHeight)/centerDistance;
      if(source===imagery){
        const normal=normalImageryLod(zoom,groundDistance,safeHeight,centerDistance,fov);
        if(Number.isFinite(normal))baseline=Math.max(normal,Math.min(baseline,
          normal+1.65*clamp((5-distanceRatio)/3,0,1),zoom+1.75));
      }
      if(!imagery||(source!==imagery&&id!=='dem'))return baseline;
      const view=terrainDetailViews.get(map);
      return view ? refineCameraTileZoom(view,id,zoom,baseline,groundDistance,fov) : baseline;
    };
  }
}

function sensorSkyStyle(index) {
  // Educational LWIR proxy: assign a low grayscale signal to clear sky before any palette.
  // Horizon is slightly warmer; no optical RGB luminance or fixed output palette color.
  // Avoid blending this sky proxy into ground pixels via the terrain fog shader.
  if(index===1)return {'sky-color':'#202020','horizon-color':'#505050','fog-color':'#505050','sky-horizon-blend':.65,'horizon-fog-blend':.55,'fog-ground-blend':1};
  return {'sky-color':'#80a9c8','horizon-color':'#c7d9e6','fog-color':'#c7d9e6','sky-horizon-blend':.65,'horizon-fog-blend':.55,'fog-ground-blend':.5};
}

function attachTerrain(map, index) {
  if (!map.getSource('dem')) map.addSource('dem', {type: 'raster-dem', tiles: [cameraDemTiles], tileSize: 256, encoding: 'terrarium', maxzoom: cameraDemMaxZoom, attribution:'Elevation: Mapzen/AWS Terrain Tiles'});
  configureCameraTileDetail(map);
  if (!map.getTerrain()) {
    map.setTerrain({source: 'dem', exaggeration: 1});
    // The bundled MapLibre 5.15 mesh is created lazily. Avoid oversampling the stable DEM.
    if(map.terrain?.meshSize===128)map.terrain.meshSize=tsdLowPower?32:64;
  }
  updateTerrainDetailView(map);
  map.setSky(sensorSkyStyle(index));
  ensure3DTargets(map, index);
  renderMissionRoute(map);
}

function setupMaps() {
  if (!window.maplibregl) { setStatusMessage('MapLibre 연결 실패 · 인터넷 연결을 확인하세요'); return; }
  try { for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    const map = new maplibregl.Map({
      container: i ? 'ir' : 'eo', style: mapStyle({cameraView:true}), center: initialPoint, zoom: 18,
      pitch: 0, bearing: 0, maxPitch: 125, maxZoom: 21, maxTileCacheSize: tsdLowPower?24:72, renderWorldCopies:false, trackResize:false,
      canvasContextAttributes: {antialias: false, preserveDrawingBuffer: false}
    });
    maps.push(map);
    if(tsdLowPower&&typeof map.setPixelRatio==='function')map.setPixelRatio(tsdPerformance.pixelRatio);
    map.setVerticalFieldOfView(sensorViewportFov(i));
    installSensorWheel(map,i);
    installZoomReference(map,i);
    cameraStyleState.set(map,'pending');
    map.on('style.load', () => {
      cameraStyleState.set(map,'pending');
      terrainOk[i]=false;
      try {
        attachTerrain(map, i);
        cameraStyleState.set(map,'ready');
      } catch (error) {
        cameraStyleState.set(map,'failed');
        setStatusMessage('3D 지형 초기화 실패 · 지도를 다시 연결해 주세요');
        console.warn(error);
      }
    });
    map.on('error', () => {
      if(!pendingDepartureView&&!flight.point&&!terrainOk.some(Boolean))setStatusMessage('온라인 지도 연결 실패 · 인터넷 연결을 확인하세요');
    });
    map.on('sourcedata', e => {
      if (cameraStyleState.get(map)!=='ready' || maps[i]!==map || e.sourceId !== 'dem' || !e.tile?.dem || !map.getTerrain()) return;
      const firstTile=!terrainOk[i];
      terrainOk[i]=true;
      if(firstTile && isVisible(i))updateTerrainDetailView(map);
      if(pendingDepartureView)finishDepartureView();
      else if(firstTile&&i===selectedIndex()&&flight.point)setStatusMessage(flight.phase==='direct'?'온라인 지형 연결 · 스틱 조종 가능':'온라인 지형 연결');
    });
    map.on('movestart', event => {
      if (syncing||!event.originalEvent) return;
      pendingDepartureView=null;
      showCameraRecovery();
      routePreviewLaunch=null;
      rememberDirectBrowse();
      if (flight.phase==='off') {
        browsedLaunchMaps.add(map);
        if (linked() && maps[1-i]) browsedLaunchMaps.add(maps[1-i]);
      }
    });
    map.on('resize', () => updateTerrainDetailView(map));
    map.on('move', () => {
      if (isVisible(i)) updateTerrainDetailView(map);
      if (syncing || !isVisible(i)) return;
      if (linked()) {
        syncIndex = i;
        if (!syncFrame) syncFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          syncFrame = 0;
          if (linked()) mirror(syncIndex);
        });
      }
      if (selectedIndex() === i || linked()) updateCameraUI(i);
    });
    map.on('moveend', () => {
      if (syncing || !isVisible(i)) return;
      if (linked()) {
        if(syncFrame){cancelAnimationFrame(syncFrame);syncFrame=0;}
        mirror(i);
      }
      if (selectedIndex() === i || linked()) updateCameraUI(i);
    });
    map.on('dragstart', () => {scanAim=null;});
    map.on('click', e => {
      if (pickMissionCenter(e.lngLat)) return;
      if (areaDrag?.moved || e.originalEvent.shiftKey || $('measure').getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true' && i === 1) return;
      scanAim = {...e.lngLat, map: i};
      selectCamera(i?'ir':eoLens);
      targetText('관찰 지점 지정 · 중앙 탐지 또는 촬영');
    });
    map.getCanvasContainer().addEventListener('pointerdown', () => {
      if (!split) return;
      selectCamera(i?'ir':eoLens);
    }, {capture: true});
    map.on('render', () => {
      if(tsdPerformance.debug)tsdPerformance.mapFrames[i]++;
      // Relay reads the WebGL buffer in the render event before optional probes.
      if (i === 1) runFlightOptional('relay-palette',()=>renderLivePalette(map.getCanvas()));
      runFlightOptional('relay-capture-'+i,()=>window.tsdEoirLink?.captureView(i,map.getCanvas()));
      runFlightOptional('sensor-check-'+i,()=>checkSensorFrame(map));
      if(i===0 && !map.isMoving() && map.areTilesLoaded()) window.tsdExposure?.sample(map.getCanvas());
      captureLiveFrame(i);
      if (i === 1) captureMeasurement();
    });
  }} catch (error) {
    terrainOk = [false, false];
    for(const map of maps.splice(0)){
      cameraStyleState.set(map,'failed');
      try{map.remove();}catch(cleanupError){console.warn(cleanupError);}
    }
    setStatusMessage('3D 지도 초기화 실패 · WebGL을 사용할 수 있는 브라우저에서 열어 주세요');
    console.warn(error);
  }
}

function resetCameraMapStyles() {
  terrainOk=[false,false];
  for(const map of maps)cameraStyleState.set(map,'pending');
  let failed=false;
  for(const map of maps){
    try{
      if(map.getTerrain())map.setTerrain(null);
      map.setStyle(mapStyle({cameraView:true}),{diff:false});
    }catch(error){
      cameraStyleState.set(map,'failed');
      failed=true;
      console.warn(error);
    }
  }
  if(failed)setStatusMessage('3D 지도 전환 실패 · 지도를 다시 연결해 주세요');
}

function cameraSnapshot(map) {
  const c = map.getCenter();
  return {center: [c.lng,c.lat], zoom: map.getZoom(), pitch: map.getPitch(), bearing: map.getBearing(),
    elevation: map.getCenterElevation(), ground: map.getCenterClampedToGround()};
}

function captureCameraAnchor(map) {
  if(!map || !(map.transform?.height||map.getCanvas().clientHeight))return null;
  const pose=cameraSnapshot(map);
  const origin=pose.ground?null:cameraOrigin(map);
  const range=cameraRange(map,pose.zoom,origin?.lat??pose.center[1]);
  return Number.isFinite(range)&&range>0?{pose,origin,range}:null;
}

function zoomForCameraRange(map,range,latitude) {
  return clamp(18+Math.log2(cameraRange(map,18,latitude)/range),5,21);
}

function renderCameraAnchor(anchor,indices) {
  const {pose,origin,range}=anchor;
  const zoom=map=>zoomForCameraRange(map,range,origin?.lat??pose.center[1]);
  if(origin)return applySensorView(origin,pose.pitch-90,pose.bearing,zoom,indices);
  const wasSyncing=syncing;
  syncing=true;
  try {
    for(const index of indices) {
      const map=maps[index];
      map.setCenterClampedToGround(true);
      map.jumpTo({...pose,zoom:zoom(map)});
    }
  } finally { syncing=wasSyncing; }
  return true;
}

function mirror(index) {
  if (maps.length !== 2 || syncing || !isVisible(1-index)) return;
  const anchor=captureCameraAnchor(maps[index]);
  if(!anchor)return;
  const dst=maps[1-index], target=cameraSnapshot(dst), pose=anchor.pose;
  const targetZoom=zoomForCameraRange(dst,anchor.range,anchor.origin?.lat??pose.center[1]);
  if(target.ground===pose.ground&&Math.abs(target.zoom-targetZoom)<.0001
    &&Math.abs(target.pitch-pose.pitch)<.001&&Math.abs(((target.bearing-pose.bearing+540)%360)-180)<.001){
    if(pose.ground&&Math.abs(target.center[0]-pose.center[0])<1e-8&&Math.abs(target.center[1]-pose.center[1])<1e-8)return;
    if(anchor.origin){
      const eye=cameraOrigin(dst);
      if(geoDistance(anchor.origin,eye)<.1&&Math.abs(anchor.origin.alt-eye.alt)<.1)return;
    }
  }
  renderCameraAnchor(anchor,[1-index]);
  updateCameraUI();
}

function resizeSensorViews(anchor,index) {
  const indices=visibleSensorIndices();
  const wasSyncing=syncing;
  syncing=true;
  try { indices.forEach(i=>maps[i].resize()); }
  finally { syncing=wasSyncing; }
  if(!indices.length)return;
  const affected=linked()?indices:[index];
  restoreResizedCamera(anchor,index,affected,true);
  indices.forEach(i=>maps[i].triggerRepaint());
}

function restoreResizedCamera(anchor,index,affected,allowNadirRecovery) {
  const wasSyncing=syncing;
  const previousFields=affected.map(i=>maps[i].getVerticalFieldOfView());
  syncing=true;
  try {
    affected.forEach(i=>{
      const map=maps[i], fov=map.getVerticalFieldOfView();
      const lat=anchor?.origin?.lat??anchor?.pose.center[1];
      const zoom=anchor?18+Math.log2(cameraRange(map,18,lat)/anchor.range):map.getZoom();
      map.setVerticalFieldOfView(sensorProjectionFov(i,fov,zoom));
    });
  } finally {syncing=wasSyncing;}
  if(pendingDepartureView){finishDepartureView();return;}
  if(!anchor)return;
  // Restore the original eye before publishing any frame from a resized sensor.
  if(renderCameraAnchor(anchor,affected)||!anchor.origin)return;
  if(allowNadirRecovery){
    const {origin,pose}=anchor;
    const ground=directGround(maps[index],origin);
    const range=Math.max(2,Number.isFinite(ground)?origin.alt-ground:anchor.range);
    applySensorView(origin,-90,pose.bearing,map=>zoomForCameraRange(map,range,origin.lat),affected);
    return;
  }
  syncing=true;
  try {affected.forEach((i,item)=>maps[i].setVerticalFieldOfView(previousFields[item]));}
  finally {syncing=wasSyncing;}
  renderCameraAnchor(anchor,affected);
}

function updateCameraUI(i=selectedIndex()) {
  const map = maps[i];
  if (!map) return;
  const tilt = map.getPitch() - 90;
  const value = Math.abs(tilt) < .05 ? 0 : tilt;
  const angle=Number(value.toFixed(1))+'°';
  $('gimbalPitch').value = value;
  $('gimbalValue').value = angle;
  $('gimbalSurvey').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(Math.abs(value+35)<.15));
  $('gimbalModeLabel').textContent=value<=-89.9?'정면 보기':'직하 보기';
  $('cameraTelemetry').textContent = '짐벌 '+angle+' · 방위 '+map.getBearing().toFixed(0)+'°';
  updateZoomUI();
}

function selectCamera(camera) {
  const previousCamera=activeCamera, previousIndex=selectedIndex();
  const anchor=captureCameraAnchor(maps[previousIndex]);
  if(camera!=='ir'&&camera!==eoLens)camera=changeEoLens(camera)?camera:eoLens;
  activeCamera = camera;
  const index=selectedIndex();
  const wanted = [!split && index===1, !split && index===0];
  const changed = wanted[0] !== $('eoWrap').hidden || wanted[1] !== $('irWrap').hidden;
  if(changed||camera!==previousCamera){
    viewRevision++;
    pendingSensorFrame=null;
    if(syncFrame){cancelAnimationFrame(syncFrame);syncFrame=0;}
  }
  setSensorMagnification(0,lensZoom[eoLens]);
  $('activeLabel').textContent = camera.toUpperCase();
  for (const [name,id] of [['wide','wide'],['zoom','zoomCamera'],['ir','irCamera']]) $(id).setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(camera===name));
  $('eoWrap').hidden = wanted[0];
  $('irWrap').hidden = wanted[1];
  $('sbs').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(split));
  if(changed && maps.length===2){
    const target=linked()||index!==previousIndex?index:(split?1-index:index);
    resizeSensorViews(anchor,target);
  }else if(camera!==previousCamera && linked()){
    // For SBS, the already visible sensor stays the source of truth.
    mirror(previousIndex);
  }
  updateCameraUI();
  updateZoomUI();
}

function jumpBoth(options, ground = true) {
  if (maps.length !== 2) return;
  syncing = true;
  try {
    for (const map of maps) {
      map.setCenterClampedToGround(ground);
      const elevation=ground&&options.center!=null?map.queryTerrainElevation(options.center):null;
      map.jumpTo(Number.isFinite(elevation)?{...options,elevation}:options);
    }
  } finally { syncing = false; }
  updateCameraUI();
}

function cameraRange(map, zoom, latitude) {
  const unit = maplibregl.MercatorCoordinate.fromLngLat([0,latitude]).meterInMercatorCoordinateUnits();
  return ((map.transform?.height||map.getCanvas().clientHeight)/2) / (Math.tan(map.getVerticalFieldOfView()*degrees/2)*512*(2**zoom)*unit);
}

function cameraOrigin(map) {
  // MapLibre 5.15 reports the rendered eye after its terrain constraints.
  const eye=map.transform?.getCameraLngLat?.();
  const altitude=map.transform?.getCameraAltitude?.();
  if(eye&&Number.isFinite(altitude))return {lng:eye.lng,lat:eye.lat,alt:altitude};
  const c = map.getCenter(), pitch = map.getPitch()*degrees, yaw = map.getBearing()*degrees;
  const range = cameraRange(map,map.getZoom(),c.lat);
  const p = maplibregl.MercatorCoordinate.fromLngLat(c);
  const du = range * p.meterInMercatorCoordinateUnits() * Math.sin(pitch);
  const origin = new maplibregl.MercatorCoordinate(p.x-du*Math.sin(yaw),p.y+du*Math.cos(yaw),0).toLngLat();
  return {lng:origin.lng, lat:origin.lat, alt:map.getCenterElevation()+cameraRange(map,map.getZoom(),origin.lat)*Math.cos(pitch)};
}

function cameraAt(map, position, tilt, yaw, zoom) {
  const pitch = 90+tilt, angle = pitch*degrees, az = yaw*degrees;
  const p = maplibregl.MercatorCoordinate.fromLngLat(position);
  const range = cameraRange(map,zoom,position.lat);
  const du = range * p.meterInMercatorCoordinateUnits() * Math.sin(angle);
  const focus = new maplibregl.MercatorCoordinate(p.x+du*Math.sin(az),p.y-du*Math.cos(az),0).toLngLat();
  return {center: focus, pitch, bearing: yaw, zoom, elevation: position.alt-range*Math.cos(angle)};
}

// Rev14e: rendering-only terrain clearance; never modify simulation altitude or route.
function tsdRenderEyeHeight(simAlt,simGround,surfaces) {
  if(!Number.isFinite(simAlt)||!Number.isFinite(simGround))return null;
  const valid=surfaces.filter(Number.isFinite);
  const nominal=Math.max(simAlt,simGround+2);
  return Math.max(nominal,...valid.map(h=>h+2));
}
function tsdVisibleSurface(map,point) {
  // Read only currently rendered DEM; never substitute an unverified zero or request new terrain here.
  if(!map?.getTerrain())return null;
  try {const h=renderedGround(map,point);return Number.isFinite(h)?h:null;}catch{return null;}
}
function aircraftLens() {
  if(!flight.point)return null;
  const surfaces=maps.filter((m,i)=>isVisible(i)).map(m=>tsdVisibleSurface(m,flight.point));
  const alt=tsdRenderEyeHeight(flight.alt,flight.ground,surfaces);
  if(!Number.isFinite(alt))return null;
  return {lng:flight.point.lng,lat:flight.point.lat,alt};
}

function visibleSensorIndices() {
  return maps.map((map,index)=>index).filter(index=>isVisible(index));
}

let pendingSensorFrame=null;
let sensorFrameProbe=null;

function showCameraRecovery(message='') {
  const feedback=$('cameraRecovery');
  feedback.value=message;
  feedback.hidden=!message;
}

function restoreSensorViews(views,poses) {
  const wasSyncing=syncing;
  syncing=true;
  try {
    views.forEach((map,index)=>{
      map.setCenterClampedToGround(poses[index].ground);
      map.jumpTo(poses[index]);
    });
  } finally { syncing=wasSyncing; }
  updateCameraUI();
}

function checkSensorFrame(map) {
  const pending=pendingSensorFrame;
  if(!pending||!pending.frames.has(map)||!map.areTilesLoaded())return;
  const expected=pending.frames.get(map);
  const current=cameraSnapshot(map);
  if(Math.abs(current.zoom-expected.zoom)>.01||Math.abs(current.pitch-expected.pitch)>.05
    ||Math.abs(current.elevation-expected.elevation)>.25
    ||Math.abs(current.center[0]-expected.center[0])>1e-6||Math.abs(current.center[1]-expected.center[1])>1e-6){
    pendingSensorFrame=null;
    return;
  }
  const canvas=map.getCanvas();
  if(canvas.width<2||canvas.height<2)return;
  let empty=false;
  try {
    if(!sensorFrameProbe){
      const sample=document.createElement('canvas');
      sample.width=sample.height=8;
      sensorFrameProbe=sample.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
    }
    const probe=sensorFrameProbe;
    probe.clearRect(0,0,8,8);
    probe.drawImage(canvas,canvas.width*.25,canvas.height*.55,canvas.width*.5,canvas.height*.35,0,0,8,8);
    const pixels=probe.getImageData(0,0,8,8).data;
    let filled=0;
    for(let i=3;i<pixels.length;i+=4)if(pixels[i]>24)filled++;
    empty=filled<8;
  } catch {
    pendingSensorFrame=null;
    return;
  }
  if(empty){
    pendingSensorFrame=null;
    requestAnimationFrame(()=>{
      if(pendingSensorFrame || pending.views.some((view,index)=>{
        const pose=cameraSnapshot(view), tested=pending.applied[index];
        return Math.abs(pose.zoom-tested.zoom)>.01||Math.abs(pose.pitch-tested.pitch)>.05
          ||Math.abs(pose.elevation-tested.elevation)>.25
          ||Math.abs(pose.center[0]-tested.center[0])>1e-6||Math.abs(pose.center[1]-tested.center[1])>1e-6;
      }))return;
      restoreSensorViews(pending.views,pending.previous);
      showCameraRecovery('영상 일부 누락 · 이전 시점 복원');
    });
  } else {
    pending.frames.delete(map);
    if(!pending.frames.size)pendingSensorFrame=null;
  }
}

function applySensorView(position,tilt,yaw,zoom,indices=visibleSensorIndices(),verifyFrame=false) {
  if(![position?.lng,position?.lat,position?.alt,tilt,yaw].every(Number.isFinite))return false;
  const views=indices.map(index=>maps[index]).filter(map=>map?.getCanvas().clientHeight>0);
  if(!views.length)return false;
  const previous=views.map(cameraSnapshot);
  const poses=views.map(map=>cameraAt(map,position,tilt,yaw,typeof zoom==='function'?zoom(map):zoom));
  if(poses.some(pose=>![pose.center.lng,pose.center.lat,pose.elevation,pose.zoom].every(Number.isFinite)))return false;
  const wasSyncing=syncing;
  let accepted=false;
  syncing=true;
  try {
    views.forEach((map,index)=>{
      map.setCenterClampedToGround(false);
      map.jumpTo(poses[index]);
    });
    accepted=views.every((map,index)=>{
      const eye=cameraOrigin(map);
      return geoDistance(position,eye)<=2&&Math.abs(eye.alt-position.alt)<=2
        &&Math.abs(map.getPitch()-(90+tilt))<=.25&&Math.abs(map.getZoom()-poses[index].zoom)<=.08
        &&Math.abs(((map.getBearing()-yaw)%360+540)%360-180)<=.25;
    });
  } catch(error) {
    accepted=false;
    console.warn('카메라 시점 적용 실패',error);
  } finally { syncing=wasSyncing; }
  if(!accepted)restoreSensorViews(views,previous);
  showCameraRecovery(accepted?'':'지형 보정으로 이전 시점 유지');
  if(accepted&&verifyFrame&&tilt<=-20){
    const applied=views.map(cameraSnapshot);
    pendingSensorFrame={views,applied,previous,frames:new Map(views.map((map,index)=>[map,applied[index]]))};
    views.forEach(map=>map.triggerRepaint());
  }
  updateCameraUI();
  return accepted;
}

function groundLaunchPoint(map=maps[selectedIndex()]) {
  if (routePreviewLaunch) return routePreviewLaunch;
  if (!map || pendingDepartureView) return departurePoint;
  const point=(map.getCenterClampedToGround() || browsedLaunchMaps.has(map)) ? map.getCenter() : cameraOrigin(map);
  return {lng:point.lng,lat:point.lat};
}

function showDepartureView(point=departurePoint) {
  if(maps.length!==2)return;
  routePreviewLaunch=null;
  maps.forEach(map=>browsedLaunchMaps.delete(map));
  if(!directControl){
    jumpBoth({center:[point.lng,point.lat],zoom:18,pitch:0,bearing:point.bearing});
    return;
  }
  const request={...point,checkingTile:true};
  pendingDepartureView=request;
  directTerrainRequest=null;
  showCameraRecovery('선택 지점의 실제 지면 고도를 확인하는 중');
  setStatusMessage(point.name+' · 지형 확인 중');
  jumpBoth({center:[point.lng,point.lat],zoom:18,pitch:0,bearing:point.bearing});
  if(finishDepartureView())return;
  prepareMissionTerrain([request]).then(tiles=>{
    if(pendingDepartureView!==request)return;
    directTerrainTiles=tiles;
    request.checkingTile=false;
    finishDepartureView();
  }).catch(()=>{
    if(pendingDepartureView!==request)return;
    request.checkingTile=false;
    if(finishDepartureView())return;
    setStatusMessage(point.name+' · 고도 타일 응답 대기');
    showCameraRecovery('고도 타일을 불러오지 못했습니다 · 기체 위치를 눌러 다시 시도');
  });
}

function finishDepartureView() {
  const request=pendingDepartureView,map=maps[selectedIndex()];
  if(!request||!directControl||!map?.getTerrain()||flight.phase!=='off')return false;
  const sampled=directTerrainTiles?missionGround(request,directTerrainTiles):null;
  if(request.checkingTile&&!Number.isFinite(sampled))return false;
  const ground=Number.isFinite(sampled)?sampled:directGround(map,request);
  if(!Number.isFinite(ground))return false;
  const position={lng:request.lng,lat:request.lat,alt:ground+directStartAgl};
  const heading=request.bearing;
  const zoomAtPitch=(view,pitch)=>clamp(18+Math.log2(cameraRange(view,18,position.lat)*Math.cos(pitch*degrees)/directStartAgl),5,21);
  const active=selectedIndex(),views=linked()?visibleSensorIndices():[active];
  const pitch=request.pitch;
  if(!applySensorView(position,pitch-90,heading,view=>zoomAtPitch(view,pitch),views)
     &&!applySensorView(position,-90,heading,view=>zoomAtPitch(view,0),views))return false;
  if(!linked()&&isVisible(1-active))applySensorView(position,pitch-90,heading,view=>zoomAtPitch(view,pitch),[1-active]);
  pendingDepartureView=null;
  Object.assign(flight,{phase:'direct',point:{lng:request.lng,lat:request.lat},alt:position.alt,ground,yaw:heading,course:heading,vs:0,speed:0});
  recenterAssistMap();
  setStatusMessage(request.name+' · 스틱 조종 가능');
  updateFlightUI();
  return true;
}

function setGimbal(value,verifyFrame=true) {
  const map = maps[selectedIndex()];
  if(typeof value!=='number' && (typeof value!=='string'||!value.trim()))return false;
  const requested=Number(value);
  if(!Number.isFinite(requested))return false;
  if (!map||pendingDepartureView||!resumeDirectBrowse()) return false;
  const tilt = clamp(requested,-90,35);
  const origin=aircraftLens()||cameraOrigin(map);
  const yaw=flight.phase==='direct'?flight.yaw:map.getBearing();
  pendingSensorFrame=null;
  const range=cameraRange(map,map.getZoom(),origin.lat);
  return applySensorView(origin,tilt,yaw,view=>zoomForCameraRange(view,range,origin.lat),linked()?visibleSensorIndices():[selectedIndex()],verifyFrame);
}

function sensorProfile(index) {
  return index===1?'ir':eoLens;
}

function lensVerticalFov(index) {
  const {diagonal,aspect}=lensProfiles[sensorProfile(index)];
  return 2*Math.atan(Math.tan(diagonal*degrees/2)/Math.hypot(1,aspect))/degrees;
}

function sensorViewportFov(index) {
  const map=maps[index], base=lensVerticalFov(index);
  const {width,height}=map?.transform??{};
  if(!(width>0&&height>0))return base;
  const nativeAspect=lensProfiles[sensorProfile(index)].aspect;
  const crop=Math.max(1,width/(height*nativeAspect));
  return 2*Math.atan(Math.tan(base*degrees/2)/crop)/degrees;
}

function magnificationFactor(index) {
  const profile=sensorProfile(index);
  return lensZoom[profile]/lensProfiles[profile].start;
}

function sensorProjectionFov(index,currentField,currentZoom) {
  const baseTangent=Math.tan(sensorViewportFov(index)*degrees/2);
  const currentTangent=Math.tan(currentField*degrees/2);
  const baseZoom=currentZoom+Math.log2(currentTangent/baseTangent);
  // Preserve camera range and cap optical zoom before MapLibre's limits; crop only the remainder.
  const optical=Math.min(magnificationFactor(index),4,2**Math.max(0,21-baseZoom));
  const tangent=baseTangent/optical;
  return 2*Math.atan(tangent)/degrees;
}

function adjustSensorOptics(index,anchor=captureCameraAnchor(maps[index])) {
  const map=maps[index];
  if(!map||!isVisible(index)||!anchor)return false;
  const fov=map.getVerticalFieldOfView(), pose=cameraSnapshot(map);
  const nextFov=sensorProjectionFov(index,fov,pose.zoom);
  if(Math.abs(nextFov-fov)<1e-5)return true;
  pendingSensorFrame=null;
  const wasSyncing=syncing;
  syncing=true;
  try {
    map.setVerticalFieldOfView(nextFov);
    if(renderCameraAnchor(anchor,[index]))return true;
    map.setVerticalFieldOfView(fov);
    restoreSensorViews([map],[pose]);
    return false;
  } finally {syncing=wasSyncing;}
}

function changeEoLens(next) {
  const map=maps[0], previous=eoLens;
  const anchor=captureCameraAnchor(map);
  eoLens=next;
  if(!map||!isVisible(0)||!anchor||adjustSensorOptics(0,anchor))return true;
  eoLens=previous;
  return false;
}

function sensorCrop(index) {
  // Native optical + digital magnification, independent of the other sensor.
  const native=(i)=>{
    const base=sensorViewportFov(i);
    const actual=maps[i]?.getVerticalFieldOfView()??base;
    const tangent=Math.tan(actual*degrees/2);
    const baseTangent=Math.tan(base*degrees/2);
    if(!Number.isFinite(tangent)||tangent<=0||!Number.isFinite(baseTangent)||baseTangent<=0)return {crop:1,tangent:NaN};
    const crop=Math.max(1,magnificationFactor(i)*tangent/baseTangent);
    return {crop,tangent:tangent/crop};
  };
  const own=native(index);
  // Linked SBS: match the displayed angular field by cropping only the wider view.
  // Do not widen beyond a native sensor's field or change its nominal zoom value.
  if(!split||!linked()||!maps[0]||!maps[1]||!isVisible(0)||!isVisible(1))return own.crop;
  const other=native(1-index);
  if(!Number.isFinite(own.tangent)||!Number.isFinite(other.tangent)||own.tangent<=0||other.tangent<=0)return own.crop;
  return own.crop*Math.max(1,own.tangent/other.tangent);
}

function sensorZoomLimit(profile) {
  return split&&linked()?Math.min(28,lensProfiles[profile].limit):lensProfiles[profile].limit;
}

function setSensorMagnification(index,value) {
  if(index!==0&&index!==1)return false;
  if(typeof value!=='number' && (typeof value!=='string'||!value.trim()))return false;
  const requested=Number(value);
  if(!Number.isFinite(requested))return false;
  const profile=sensorProfile(index), previous=lensZoom[profile];
  lensZoom[profile]=clamp(requested,lensProfiles[profile].start,sensorZoomLimit(profile));
  // Hidden sensors retain the requested zoom until the viewport is shown and restored.
  if(!maps[index]||!isVisible(index))return true;
  try {
    if(adjustSensorOptics(index))return true;
  } catch(error) {
    console.warn('Sensor optics update failed',error);
  }
  lensZoom[profile]=previous;
  return false;
}

function updateZoomUI() {
  for(const index of [0,1]) {
    const profile=sensorProfile(index);
    const zoom=lensZoom[profile].toFixed(2)+'×';
    $(index?'ir':'eo').style.setProperty('--sensor-crop',String(sensorCrop(index)));
    const label=index?($('palette').value?palettes[$('palette').value].label.toUpperCase():'WHITE HOT'):profile.toUpperCase();
    const badge=$(index?'irBadge':'eoBadge');
    badge.textContent=(index?'IR':'EO')+' · '+label+' '+zoom+(split&&linked()?' · MATCH':'');
    badge.title=split&&linked()?'센서 고유 배율 · 비교용 공통 화각(좁은 쪽 기준 크롭)':'센서 고유 배율 및 화각';
  }
  $('zoomLabel').value=lensZoom[sensorProfile(selectedIndex())].toFixed(2)+'×';
}

function zoomStep(logDelta,index=selectedIndex()) {
  const ratio=2**logDelta;
  const indices=linked()?[0,1]:[index];
  for(const i of indices)setSensorMagnification(i,lensZoom[sensorProfile(i)]*ratio);
  updateZoomUI();
}

function wheelPixels(event) {
  return event.deltaY*(event.deltaMode===1?16:event.deltaMode===2?120:1);
}

function installSensorWheel(map,index) {
  map.getCanvasContainer().addEventListener('wheel',event=>{
    if(!flight.point&&map.getCenterClampedToGround())return;
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopImmediatePropagation();
    const delta=clamp(-wheelPixels(event)/1200,-.12,.12);
    if(zoomInput.wheelIndex!==index)zoomInput.wheel=0;
    zoomInput.wheel=clamp(zoomInput.wheel+delta,-.6,.6);
    zoomInput.wheelIndex=index;
    if(split&&selectedIndex()!==index)selectCamera(index?'ir':eoLens);
  },{capture:true,passive:false});
}

function bindZoomButton(button,direction) {
  const release=(event)=>{
    if(zoomInput.held?.button===button&&event?.pointerId===zoomInput.held.pointerId)zoomInput.held=null;
  };
  button.addEventListener('pointerdown',event=>{
    if(event.button!==0||zoomInput.held)return;
    button.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);
    zoomInput.held={button,pointerId:event.pointerId,direction,index:selectedIndex()};
    zoomInput.delay=.15;
    zoomInput.wheel=0;
    zoomStep(direction*.045);
  });
  for(const type of ['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture'])button.addEventListener(type,release);
  button.addEventListener('click',event=>{if(event.detail===0)zoomStep(direction*.045);});
}

function advanceZoomInput(dt) {
  const held=zoomInput.held;
  if(held) {
    zoomInput.delay=Math.max(0,zoomInput.delay-dt);
    if(!zoomInput.delay)zoomStep(held.direction*.75*dt,held.index);
  }
  if(zoomInput.wheel) {
    const step=Math.abs(zoomInput.wheel)<.001?zoomInput.wheel:zoomInput.wheel*Math.min(1,dt*18);
    zoomInput.wheel-=step;
    if(step)zoomStep(step,zoomInput.wheelIndex);
  }
}

function installZoomReference(map,index) {
  const overlay=document.createElement('div');
  overlay.className='zoomReference';
  overlay.hidden=true;
  overlay.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  for(const distance of [100,200]){
    const mark=document.createElement('i');
    mark.dataset.distance='지상 '+distance+' m';
    mark.hidden=true;
    overlay.appendChild(mark);
  }
  map.getContainer().appendChild(overlay);
  zoomReference[index]=overlay;
}

function referenceLocation(origin,distance,bearing){
  const angle=distance/6371000, heading=bearing*degrees, latitude=origin.lat*degrees;
  const lat=Math.asin(Math.sin(latitude)*Math.cos(angle)+Math.cos(latitude)*Math.sin(angle)*Math.cos(heading));
  const lon=Math.atan2(Math.sin(heading)*Math.sin(angle)*Math.cos(latitude),
    Math.cos(angle)-Math.sin(latitude)*Math.sin(lat));
  return {lng:origin.lng+lon/degrees,lat:lat/degrees};
}

function screenTerrainHit(map,pixel){
  if(!map.terrain)return null;
  const hit=map.terrain.pointCoordinate(pixel);
  if(!hit)return null;
  const point=hit.toLngLat();
  if(!Number.isFinite(directGround(map,point))||!Number.isFinite(hit.z))return null;
  return {lng:point.lng,lat:point.lat,alt:hit.z};
}

function updateZoomReference(index){
  const frame=zoomReference[index],map=maps[index];
  if(!frame||!map)return;
  const active=index===selectedIndex(),out=$('zoomTestReadout');
  const enabled=$('zoomTest').getAttribute('aria-pressed')==='true';
  frame.hidden=!enabled||!isVisible(index);
  if(frame.hidden)return;
  const canvas=map.getCanvas(),width=canvas.clientWidth,height=canvas.clientHeight;
  if(!width||!height)return;
  const origin=cameraOrigin(map),center={x:width/2,y:height/2};
  const bearing=map.getBearing(),tilt=(map.getPitch()-90)*degrees,crop=sensorCrop(index);
  for(const [i,mark] of [...frame.children].entries()){
    mark.hidden=true;
    if(pendingDepartureView||!terrainOk[index])continue;
    const distance=(i+1)*100,point=referenceLocation(origin,distance,bearing);
    const altitude=renderedGround(map,point);
    if(!Number.isFinite(altitude)||distance*Math.cos(tilt)+(altitude-origin.alt)*Math.sin(tilt)<=0)continue;
    const pixel=map.transform.coordinatePoint(maplibregl.MercatorCoordinate.fromLngLat(point),altitude,map.transform._pixelMatrix3D);
    const x=center.x+(pixel.x-center.x)*crop,y=center.y+(pixel.y-center.y)*crop;
    if(!(x>=8&&x<=width-8&&y>=18&&y<=height-8))continue;
    const hit=screenTerrainHit(map,pixel);
    if(!hit||geoDistance(point,hit)>8)continue;
    mark.style.left=x+'px';mark.style.top=y+'px';
    mark.hidden=false;
  }
  if(active){
    const hit=pendingDepartureView||!terrainOk[index]?null:screenTerrainHit(map,center);
    const distance=hit?Math.hypot(geoDistance(origin,hit),origin.alt-hit.alt):null;
    const value=distance===null?'중앙 조준 거리 —':'중앙 조준 거리 '+formatDistance(distance);
    if(out.value!==value)out.value=value;
  }
}

function clearMarkers(markers) {
  markers.forEach(m => m.remove());
  markers.length = 0;
}

function drawMarker(lngLat, kind, hit = false) {
  return maps.map(map => {
    const element = document.createElement('div');
    element.className = kind + (hit ? ' hit' : '');
    if (kind === 'observationPin') element.textContent = '◎';
    element.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    const marker = new maplibregl.Marker({element, anchor: 'center'}).setLngLat(lngLat).addTo(map);
    return marker;
  });
}

function markAt(lngLat) {
  clearMarkers(markPins);
  markPins = drawMarker(lngLat, 'observationPin');
  observationPoint={lng:lngLat[0],lat:lngLat[1]};
  $('lookAt').disabled=false;
}
function clearObservation() {
  clearMarkers(markPins);
  observationPoint=null;
  $('lookAt').disabled=true;
}
function lookAtObservation() {
  const map=maps[selectedIndex()];
  if(!map||!observationPoint)return;
  const origin=aircraftLens()||cameraOrigin(map);
  const ground=map.queryTerrainElevation(observationPoint);
  if(!Number.isFinite(ground)){targetText('표식의 지형을 불러오는 중입니다');return;}
  const distance=geoDistance(origin,observationPoint);
  const tilt=clamp(-Math.atan2(origin.alt-ground,Math.max(.01,distance))/degrees,-90,0);
  const yaw=distance>.1?bearingTo(origin,observationPoint):map.getBearing();
  if(missionActive()&&mission.state!=='paused')pauseMission('표식 보기 · 임무 일시정지');
  if(applySensorView(origin,tilt,yaw,map.getZoom(),linked()?visibleSensorIndices():[selectedIndex()])
     && (flight.phase==='air'||flight.phase==='direct')){
    flight.yaw=yaw;
    directBrowseView=null;
  }
}

function scanTarget() {
  const map = maps[selectedIndex()];
  if (!map) return;
  if(!scanAim && map.getPitch()>=90){targetText('수평 또는 상향 시점입니다 · 지표면의 관찰 지점을 클릭하세요');return;}
  const pos = scanAim || map.unproject([map.getCanvas().clientWidth/2,map.getCanvas().clientHeight/2]);
  if (!validCoordinates(pos.lng,pos.lat)) { targetText('지표면의 관찰 지점을 선택하세요'); return; }
  clearMarkers(scanPins);
  const zoom = maps[scanAim?.map ?? selectedIndex()].getZoom();
  const tolerance = clamp(10*2*Math.PI*6371008.8*Math.cos(pos.lat*degrees)/(512*2**zoom),1.5,12);
  const nearest=nearestScanTarget(pos);
  const hit=nearest&&zoom>=14&&nearest.distance<=Math.max(tolerance,nearest.target.radius||0);
  scanPins=drawMarker([pos.lng,pos.lat],'detectionRing',Boolean(hit&&!nearest.target.decoy));
  scanCount++;
  if(hit){
    const target=nearest.target;
    if(target.decoy){
      falseScanCount++;
      targetAudit();
      targetText('오탐 · 유사 표적 · 오탐 '+falseScanCount+'회');
    } else {
      const already=target.found;
      target.found=true;
      targetAudit();
      targetText((already?'다시 확인':'탐지 성공')+' · #'+target.id+' · '+scanCount+'회');
    }
  } else targetText(!missionTargets.length?'표적 미배치':zoom<14?'원본 영상 상세도가 부족합니다':'미탐지 · '+scanCount+'회');
}

function validCoordinates(lng,lat) { return Number.isFinite(lng)&&Number.isFinite(lat)&&lng>=124&&lng<=133&&lat>=32.9&&lat<=39; }
function moveToRegion(lng,lat,name) {
  if (!validCoordinates(lng,lat)||maps.length!==2) { setStatusMessage('이동 좌표를 확인할 수 없습니다'); return; }
  tsdCancelPanorama(false);
  document.dispatchEvent(new Event('tsd-camera-reset'));
  departurePoint = {lng,lat,pitch:40,bearing:-25,name};
  clearMission();
  directControl=true;
  resetFlight();
  mouseAxes.fill(0);
  clearKeyboardControls();
  pendingSensorFrame=null;
  showCameraRecovery();
  scanAim = null;
  clearMarkers(scanPins);
  clearObservation();
  showDepartureView();
  setFlightPanel(true);
  recenterAssistMap();
}

const adminRows = JSON.parse($('adminData').textContent);
const regionIndex = new Map();
function indexRegions(rows) {
  for (const [key,name,lng,lat,children] of rows) {
    regionIndex.set(key,{key,name,lng,lat,children});
    if(children)indexRegions(children);
  }
}
indexRegions(adminRows);
function fillRegions(id,rows,placeholder) {
  const select = $(id);
  select.replaceChildren(new Option(placeholder,''));
  for (const [key,name] of rows) select.add(new Option(name,key));
  select.disabled = rows.length===0;
}
function activeRegion(id) { return regionIndex.get($(id).value); }

function districtChanged() {
  const parent = activeRegion('district');
  const children = parent?.children || [];
  mountainSelection=null;
  fillRegions('town',children,'읍·면·동 선택');
  $('place').value='';
  placeSelection=null;
  refreshSpots();
}
function provinceChanged() {
  const region = activeRegion('province');
  fillRegions('district',region?.children || [],'시·군·구 선택');
  if (region?.name==='세종특별자치시') $('district').value=region.children[0][0];
  districtChanged();
}
function moveSelected() {
  const town=activeRegion('town'), district=activeRegion('district'), province=activeRegion('province');
  const region=town||district||province;
  if(!region) {setStatusMessage('이동할 지역을 선택하세요');return;}
  const name=[province,district,town].filter(Boolean).map(x=>x.name).filter((s,i,a)=>i===0||s!==a[i-1]).join(' ');
  moveToRegion(region.lng,region.lat,name);
  refreshSpots();
}

const placeCategories={
 mountain:{id:'mountains', label:'산'},
 trail:{id:'trails', label:'등산로'},
 river:{id:'rivers', label:'강'},
 recreation:{id:'recreation', label:'유원지'},
 recommended:{id:'suggestions', label:'추천 명소'}
};
const placeDb=JSON.parse($('placeData').textContent).map((row,index)=>{
 const [category,province,district,town,name,lat,lng,type,ref,rank]=row;
 return {index,category,province,district,town,name,lat,lng,type,ref,rank};
});
let placeSelection=null;
const placeNameOrder=new Intl.Collator('ko',{numeric:true});

let missionTargets=[], supervisorReveal=false, scanCount=0, falseScanCount=0;
let targetDeploymentArea=null;
let targetElapsed=0, targetMotionAt=0, targetMotionRevision=0;
const personWalkSpeed=2/3.6;
const fireSpreadSpeed=.06;

function nearestScanTarget(point) {
  let closest=null;
  for(const target of missionTargets) {
    const distance=geoDistance(point,target);
    if(!closest||distance<closest.distance)closest={target,distance};
  }
  return closest;
}

function createWalkingRoute(start, index) {
  const angle=index*2.39996, radius=24+(index%5)*8;
  const center=offsetPoint(start,-Math.cos(angle)*radius,-Math.sin(angle)*radius);
  const points=[{lng:start.lng,lat:start.lat}];
  for(let i=1;i<6;i++){
    const heading=angle+i*Math.PI/3;
    points.push(offsetPoint(center,Math.cos(heading)*radius,Math.sin(heading)*radius));
  }
  const lengths=points.map((point,i)=>geoDistance(point,points[(i+1)%points.length]));
  return {points,lengths,total:lengths.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)};
}

function updateMovingTargets(dt) {
  targetElapsed+=dt;
  for(const target of missionTargets){
    if(target.route){
      const {points,lengths,total}=target.route;
      let distance=targetElapsed*target.speed%total,index=0;
      while(index<lengths.length-1&&distance>=lengths[index])distance-=lengths[index++];
      const from=points[index],to=points[(index+1)%points.length],ratio=distance/lengths[index];
      target.lng=from.lng+(to.lng-from.lng)*ratio;
      target.lat=from.lat+(to.lat-from.lat)*ratio;
      target.heading=bearingTo(from,to);
    }
    if(target.kind==='fire')target.radius=Math.min(18,.8+targetElapsed*fireSpreadSpeed);
  }
  targetMotionRevision++;
  for(const marker of targetPins)marker.setLngLat(marker.trainingTarget);
  for(const [index,map] of maps.entries())if(isVisible(index))map.triggerRepaint();
}

function tickTargetMotion(now) {
  if(!missionTargets.some(t=>t.route||t.kind==='fire')||document.hidden){targetMotionAt=now;return;}
  if(now-targetMotionAt<(tsdLowPower?150:85))return;
  const elapsed=(now-targetMotionAt)/1000;
  targetMotionAt=now;
  updateMovingTargets(Math.min(.35,elapsed));
}
const targetPins=[];

function geoDistance(a,b){const r=Math.PI/180,dy=(a.lat-b.lat)*r,dx=(a.lng-b.lng)*r;return 6371000*2*Math.asin(Math.sqrt(Math.sin(dy/2)**2+Math.cos(a.lat*r)*Math.cos(b.lat*r)*Math.sin(dx/2)**2))}
const target3DLayers=[];
// V23: simulated thermal radiometry. Educational approximation, NOT calibrated LWIR.
const THERMAL={person:{skin:34,cloth:27,eps:.97,size:[.5,1.7]},vehicle:{bodyOffset:5,engine:75,eps:.85,size:[1.8,4.5]},fire:{flame:800,eps:.95,size:[1.2,1.2]},hotspot:{flame:95,eps:.92,size:[1,1.2]}};
const thermalDefaults=Object.freeze({temperature_2m:20,shortwave_radiation:300,cloud_cover:40,relative_humidity_2m:55});
const thermalState={env:{...thermalDefaults},source:'기본 모의값',updated:0,hasWeather:false,agcMin:10,agcMax:45};
function normalizeThermalEnv(env){
 if(!env||typeof env.temperature_2m!=='number'||!Number.isFinite(env.temperature_2m))throw Error('온도 데이터 누락');
 const finite=(key,min,max)=>typeof env[key]==='number'&&Number.isFinite(env[key])?Math.max(min,Math.min(max,env[key])):thermalDefaults[key];
 return {temperature_2m:finite('temperature_2m',-90,65),shortwave_radiation:finite('shortwave_radiation',0,1500),cloud_cover:finite('cloud_cover',0,100),relative_humidity_2m:finite('relative_humidity_2m',0,100)};
}
const clamp01=x=>Math.min(1,Math.max(0,x));
function groundTemp(env,slopeFactor=1,albedo=.2){
 const air=Number.isFinite(Number(env.temperature_2m))?Number(env.temperature_2m):20,solar=Math.max(0,Number(env.shortwave_radiation)||0);
 const clouds=clamp01((Number(env.cloud_cover)||0)/100);
 return air+solar*(1-clamp01(albedo))*Math.max(0,slopeFactor)*.02-(solar<10?3*(1-.7*clouds):0);
}
async function getEnv(lat,lng){
 const url=new URL('https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast');
 url.searchParams.set('latitude',lat);url.searchParams.set('longitude',lng);
 url.searchParams.set('current','temperature_2m,shortwave_radiation,cloud_cover,relative_humidity_2m');
 const ctrl=new AbortController(),timeout=setTimeout(()=>ctrl.abort(),6500);
 try{const response=await fetch(url,{signal:ctrl.signal});if(!response.ok)throw Error('HTTP '+response.status);
 const data=(await response.json()).current;return normalizeThermalEnv(data);
 }finally{clearTimeout(timeout)}
}
function baseTemp(kind,env){const a=Number.isFinite(Number(env.temperature_2m))?Number(env.temperature_2m):20,s=THERMAL[kind];
 if(!s)throw Error('알 수 없는 목표물 종류: '+kind);
 if(kind==='person')return {skin:s.skin,cloth:s.cloth};
 if(kind==='vehicle')return {body:a+s.bodyOffset,engine:s.engine};
 return {flame:s.flame};
}
function targetPartTemp(t,part){const v=t.temp||baseTemp(t.kind,thermalState.env);
 return Number(v[part]??v.cloth??v.body??v.flame??thermalState.env.temperature_2m);
}
function apparentTemp(t,env,distM,fillFraction,part){
 const air=Number.isFinite(Number(env.temperature_2m))?Number(env.temperature_2m):20,background=groundTemp(env,1),T=targetPartTemp(t,part);
 const eps=clamp01(Number(t.eps??THERMAL[t.kind]?.eps??.95));
 const tau=Math.exp(-.0002*Math.max(0,distM));const f=clamp01(fillFraction);
 const k=x=>Math.max(1,x+273.15),pow=x=>Math.pow(k(x),4);
 const Lobj=eps*pow(T)+(1-eps)*pow(background);
 const Lair=tau*Lobj+(1-tau)*pow(air);
 return Math.pow(f*Lair+(1-f)*pow(background),.25)-273.15;
}
const thermalSensorRanges=Object.freeze({high:Object.freeze([-20,150]),low:Object.freeze([0,500])});
function thermalSensorRange(gain=$('gain').value){return [...(thermalSensorRanges[gain]||thermalSensorRanges.high)];}
// Shared synthetic source encoding, independent of gain. Not radiometric data.
function thermalSourceRange(){if(recording?.indices.includes(1)&&Array.isArray(recording.sourceRange))return [...recording.sourceRange];const bg=groundTemp(thermalState.env,1),air=thermalState.env.temperature_2m;return [Math.min(bg-8,air-8),Math.max(bg+15,air+18)];}
function thermalRange(gain=$('gain').value){const [a,b]=thermalSourceRange(),[min,max]=thermalSensorRange(gain);
 // Educational AGC: low gain uses a wider scene window, not the full sensor span.
 const center=(a+b)/2,half=(b-a)/2*(gain==='low'?1.65:1);
 const lo=clamp(center-half,min,max-1),hi=clamp(center+half,lo+1,max);return [lo,hi];
}
function thermalProfile(){const gain=recording?.indices.includes(1)?recording.gain:$('gain').value;return {gain,source:thermalSourceRange(),sensor:thermalSensorRange(gain),display:thermalDisplayRange()};}
// Quantization and fixed-pattern noise parameters are illustrative, not DJI calibration or NETD.
function thermalGainLUT(profile){const {gain,source,sensor,display}=profile,step=gain==='low'?1:.1,noise=gain==='low'?.45:.05;const lut=new Uint8Array(1024);for(let p=0;p<4;p++)for(let i=0;i<256;i++){const t=source[0]+i/255*(source[1]-source[0]);const sampled=clamp(Math.round((t+noise*[-1,.4,-.4,1][p])/step)*step,sensor[0],sensor[1]);lut[p*256+i]=clamp(Math.round((sampled-display[0])/(display[1]-display[0])*255),0,255);}return lut;}
let thermalGainCache=null;
function cachedThermalGainLUT(profile){const key=JSON.stringify(profile);if(thermalGainCache?.key!==key)thermalGainCache={key,lut:thermalGainLUT(profile)};return thermalGainCache.lut;}
function applyThermalGain(data,profile=thermalProfile()){const lut=cachedThermalGainLUT(profile);for(let i=0;i<data.length;i+=4){const lum=clamp(Math.round(data[i]*.2126+data[i+1]*.7152+data[i+2]*.0722),0,255);const p=((i>>>2)^((i>>>2)>>>7))&3;const v=lut[p*256+lum];data[i]=data[i+1]=data[i+2]=v;}return data;}

// Fuse the two per-pixel passes; cache the combined table until profile or palette changes.
let thermalPaletteCache=null;
const tsdThermalOverlay={iso:false,min:25,max:40,alarm:false,threshold:45};
function tsdOverlayTemperature(profile,p,i){const step=profile.gain==='low'?1:.1,noise=profile.gain==='low'?.45:.05;return clamp(Math.round((profile.source[0]+i/255*(profile.source[1]-profile.source[0])+noise*[-1,.4,-.4,1][p])/step)*step,profile.sensor[0],profile.sensor[1]);}
function tsdHeatStatus(hit,valid=true){const el=$('tsdHeatAlert');if(!el)return;const visible=tsdThermalOverlay.alarm&&valid&&hit&&isVisible(1);if(el.hidden===visible)el.hidden=!visible;}
function tsdInvalidateOverlay(){thermalPaletteCache=null;tsdPerformance.paletteLast=-Infinity;maps[1]?.triggerRepaint();}

function applyThermalPalette(data,table,profile=thermalProfile(),overlay=null){
 const gain=cachedThermalGainLUT(profile);
 const key=overlay&&(overlay.iso||overlay.alarm)?JSON.stringify(overlay):'';
 if(thermalPaletteCache?.gain!==gain||thermalPaletteCache?.table!==table||thermalPaletteCache?.key!==key){
  const rgb=new Uint8Array(3072),flags=overlay?.alarm?new Uint8Array(1024):null;
  for(let i=0;i<1024;i++){const j=3*gain[i];let highlight=false;
   if(key){const t=tsdOverlayTemperature(profile,i>>>8,i&255);highlight=overlay.iso&&t>=overlay.min&&t<=overlay.max;if(flags)flags[i]=Number(t>=overlay.threshold);}
   rgb[3*i]=highlight?255:table[j];rgb[3*i+1]=highlight?222:table[j+1];rgb[3*i+2]=highlight?0:table[j+2];}
  thermalPaletteCache={gain,table,rgb,key,flags};
 }
 const {rgb,flags}=thermalPaletteCache;let hit=false;
 for(let i=0;i<data.length;i+=4){const lum=clamp(Math.round(data[i]*.2126+data[i+1]*.7152+data[i+2]*.0722),0,255);const p=((i>>>2)^((i>>>2)>>>7))&3;const k=p*256+lum,j=3*k;if(flags&&!hit&&data[i+3]&&flags[k])hit=true;data[i]=rgb[j];data[i+1]=rgb[j+1];data[i+2]=rgb[j+2];}
 if(overlay)tsdHeatStatus(hit);
