}

function thermalRangeText(range){return range.map(v=>Number(v.toFixed(1))).join(' ~ ')+' °C';}
function refreshThermalRangeNote(){const el=$('tsdThermalRangeNote');if(!el)return;const gain=recording?.indices.includes(1)?recording.gain:$('gain').value;const sensor=thermalSensorRange(gain),display=thermalDisplayRange();const text='센서 규격 '+thermalRangeText(sensor)+' · AGC '+thermalRangeText(display)+' · 교육용 밝기 환산'+(recording?.indices.includes(1)?' (녹화 중 고정)':'');if(el.textContent!==text)el.textContent=text;}

function approximateSensorDistance(map,t){
 const origin=cameraOrigin(map);
 return Math.hypot(geoDistance(origin,t),origin.alt-t.elevation);
}
function thermalPixelFill(map,t,dist){
 // IFOV placeholder: 640px across a 24 degree horizontal FOV. No fake map zoom threshold.
 const ifov=(24*Math.PI/180)/640,area=t.kind==='person'?.5*.9:t.kind==='vehicle'?1.8*2.8:t.kind==='fire'?Math.PI*t.radius*t.radius:1.2;
 return clamp01(area/Math.max(.0001,(dist*ifov)**2));
}
function updateThermalMeshes(map,objects){
 const env=thermalState.env,[lo,hi]=thermalSourceRange();
 for(const root of objects||[]){const t=root.userData.target;if(!t)continue;
 const dist=approximateSensorDistance(map,t),fill=thermalPixelFill(map,t,dist);
 root.traverse(o=>{if(!o.userData.thermalPart)return;
 const temp=apparentTemp(t,env,dist,fill,o.userData.thermalPart);
 const level=clamp01((temp-lo)/(hi-lo));
 o.material.color.setRGB(level,level,level).convertLinearToSRGB();});
 }
}
async function refreshThermalEnvironment(lat,lng){
 const stamp=++thermalState.updated;
 try{const env=await getEnv(lat,lng);if(stamp!==thermalState.updated)return;
 thermalState.env=normalizeThermalEnv(env);thermalState.hasWeather=true;thermalState.source='Open-Meteo 모의 환경';}
 catch(err){if(stamp!==thermalState.updated)return;thermalState.source=thermalState.hasWeather?'이전 기상 모의값 (기상 API 실패)':'기본 모의값 (기상 API 실패)';}
 for(const t of missionTargets){t.temp=baseTemp(t.kind,thermalState.env)}
 maps.forEach(m=>m?.triggerRepaint());
}

// V23.3: target-only visual geometry enhancement; terrain and palette filters unchanged.
function makeTargetMesh(t,thermal=false){
 const root=new THREE.Group();
 const material=(hex)=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:hex,roughness:.83,metalness:.04});
 const eo=thermal?null:{cloth:material(t.decoy?0x626c86:0x3d5042),skin:material(0xb68d73),body:material(t.decoy?0x7a8d86:0xd5d9d7),glass:material(0x30444e),wheel:material(0x202225),lamp:material(0xe8d5ad),engine:material(0xc1c5c2),flame:material(0xff8b19),ember:material(0xe33b0e)};
 function mesh(geometry,part,x=0,y=0,z=0,rotation=null){
  const material=thermal?new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x888888}):eo[part];
  const m=new THREE.Mesh(geometry,material);m.position.set(x,y,z);
  if(rotation)m.rotation.set(...rotation);
  m.userData.thermalPart=['lamp','wheel','glass'].includes(part)?'body':part==='ember'?'flame':part;
  root.add(m);return m;
 }
 const box=(w,d,h,part,x,y,z)=>mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w,d,h),part,x,y,z);
 const sphere=(r,part,x,y,z)=>mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(r,12,9),part,x,y,z);
 const limb=(a,b,r,part)=>{
  const va=new THREE.Vector3(...a),vb=new THREE.Vector3(...b),dir=vb.clone().sub(va);
  const m=mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(r,r*.9,dir.length(),9),part,...va.clone().add(vb).multiplyScalar(.5).toArray());
  m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(new THREE.Vector3(0,1,0),dir.normalize());
 };
 if(t.kind==='person'){
  // Anatomical silhouette 1.7 m tall, no billboard or oversized locator.
  sphere(.115,'skin',0,0,1.585);
  mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.09,.085,.12,10),'skin',0,0,1.43,[Math.PI/2,0,0]);
  box(.42,.24,.61,'cloth',0,0,1.10);
  box(.33,.24,.15,'cloth',0,0,.75);
  limb([-.16,0,.75],[-.16,0,.10],.075,'cloth');
  limb([.16,0,.75],[.16,0,.10],.075,'cloth');
  limb([-.27,0,1.34],[-.33,0,.91],.061,'cloth');
  limb([.27,0,1.34],[.33,0,.91],.061,'cloth');
  sphere(.066,'skin',-.33,0,.87);sphere(.066,'skin',.33,0,.87);
 }else if(t.kind==='vehicle'){
  // 4.5 m x 1.8 m vehicle with distinguishable cabin, bonnet and wheels.
  box(1.8,4.5,.57,'body',0,0,.69);
  box(1.65,2.3,.58,'body',0,-.35,1.23);
  box(1.48,.035,.38,'glass',0,-1.51,1.31);
  box(1.48,.035,.36,'glass',0,.82,1.31);
  for(const x of [-.88,.88])for(const y of [-1.48,1.48]){
   mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.34,.34,.19,14),'wheel',x,y,.34,[0,0,Math.PI/2]);
  }
  for(const x of [-.58,.58])box(.28,.045,.14,'lamp',x,2.255,.77);
  // The front engine region has its own thermal response.
  box(1.15,.72,.055,'engine',0,1.42,1.015);
 }else if(t.kind==='fire'){
  // Layered flame shape: physical scale, not an always-visible marker.
  for(const [x,y,z,r,h] of [[0,0,.65,.46,1.3],[-.22,.08,.54,.25,.95],[.22,-.08,.53,.23,1.02]]){
   mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(r,h,9),'flame',x,y,z,[Math.PI/2,0,0]);
  }
  for(const [x,y] of [[-.34,0],[.35,.18],[-.23,-.35],[.20,.38],[.6,-.34]])sphere(.18,'ember',x,y,.16);
 }else if(t.kind==='hotspot'){
  box(.93,.62,.10,'ember',0,0,.12);
  box(.44,.24,.24,'ember',.10,0,.27);
 }
 root.userData.target=t;
 return root;
}
function target3DLayer(map,i){
 const id='tsd-real-size-targets-'+i;
 const layer={id,type:'custom',renderingMode:'3d',
 onAdd(m,gl){
  this.camera=new THREE.Camera();
  this.scene=new THREE.Scene();
  this.localToMercator=new THREE.Matrix4();
  this.targetObjects=[];
  this.refreshGround=()=>{this.groundDirty=true;};
  this.onDemLoaded=e=>{if(e.sourceId==='dem'&&e.isSourceLoaded)this.refreshGround();};
  m.on('moveend',this.refreshGround);
  m.on('sourcedata',this.onDemLoaded);
  this.scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff,1.3));
  const sun=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff,1.3);
  sun.position.set(40,50,100);
  this.scene.add(sun);
  this.renderer=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas:m.getCanvas(),context:gl,antialias:false});
  this.renderer.autoClear=false;
 },
 clearTargets(){
  for(const root of this.targetObjects){
   this.scene.remove(root);
   const materials=new Set();
   root.traverse(mesh=>{
    if(!mesh.isMesh)return;
    mesh.geometry.dispose();
    materials.add(mesh.material);
   });
   materials.forEach(material=>material.dispose());
  }
  this.targetObjects=[];
 },
 render(gl,args){
  if(this.version!==targetMeshVersion){
   this.clearTargets();
   this.version=targetMeshVersion;
   this.refreshGround();
   this.motionRevision=-1;
   const first=missionTargets[0];
   if(first){
    const origin=maplibregl.MercatorCoordinate.fromLngLat(first,first.elevation);
    const unit=origin.meterInMercatorCoordinateUnits();
    this.targetOrigin=origin;
    this.localUnit=unit;
    this.localToMercator.makeScale(unit,unit,unit).setPosition(origin.x,origin.y,origin.z);
    for(const target of missionTargets){
     const root=makeTargetMesh(target,i===1);
     this.scene.add(root);
     this.targetObjects.push(root);
    }
   }
  }
  if(!this.targetObjects.length)return;
  const terrainUpdated=this.groundDirty&&map.isSourceLoaded('dem');
  if(terrainUpdated||this.motionRevision!==targetMotionRevision){
   this.motionRevision=targetMotionRevision;
   if(terrainUpdated)this.groundDirty=false;
   const bounds=map.getBounds(), origin=this.targetOrigin, unit=this.localUnit;
   for(const root of this.targetObjects){
    const target=root.userData.target;
    if(bounds.contains(target)){
     const elevation=map.queryTerrainElevation(target);
     if(Number.isFinite(elevation)&&(elevation!==0||target.elevation===0))root.userData.ground=elevation;
    }
    const position=maplibregl.MercatorCoordinate.fromLngLat(target,(root.userData.ground??target.elevation)+.08);
    const scale=position.meterInMercatorCoordinateUnits()/unit;
    root.position.set((position.x-origin.x)/unit,(position.y-origin.y)/unit,(position.z-origin.z)/unit);
    if(target.kind==='fire'){
     const growth=target.radius/.8;
     root.scale.set(scale*growth,scale*growth,scale*Math.min(2.3,1+Math.log(growth)*.45));
    } else {
     root.scale.setScalar(scale);
     if(target.route)root.rotation.z=target.heading*degrees;
    }
   }
  }

  // Compose on the CPU before passing float32 uniforms to WebGL.
  // The local scene uses east, south and up, matching the Mercator axes.
  this.camera.projectionMatrix.fromArray(args.defaultProjectionData.mainMatrix).multiply(this.localToMercator);
  this.camera.projectionMatrixInverse.copy(this.camera.projectionMatrix).invert();
  if(i===1&&
      (this.thermalVersion!==targetMeshVersion||this.thermalWeather!==thermalState.env||performance.now()-this.lastThermalUpdate>250)){
   updateThermalMeshes(map,this.targetObjects);
   this.thermalVersion=targetMeshVersion;
   this.thermalWeather=thermalState.env;
   this.lastThermalUpdate=performance.now();
  }
  this.renderer.resetState();
  this.renderer.setViewport(0,0,gl.drawingBufferWidth,gl.drawingBufferHeight);
  this.renderer.render(this.scene,this.camera);
 },
 onRemove(m){
  m.off('moveend',this.refreshGround);
  m.off('sourcedata',this.onDemLoaded);
  this.clearTargets();
  this.renderer.dispose();
 }
 };
 map.addLayer(layer);target3DLayers[i]=layer;
}
let targetMeshVersion=0;
function drawTargetPins(){
 clearMarkers(targetPins);
 if(!supervisorReveal)return;
 for(const m of maps)for(const t of missionTargets){
  const el=document.createElement('button');
  el.type='button';el.className='supervisorLocator';
  el.textContent=String(t.id);el.title='감독관 표적 #'+t.id;
  el.onclick=e=>{e.stopPropagation();supervisorInspectTarget(t.id);};
  const pin=new maplibregl.Marker({element:el,anchor:'bottom',offset:[0,-12]}).setLngLat(t).addTo(m);
  pin.trainingTarget=t;
  targetPins.push(pin);
 }
}
function ensure3DTargets(map,i){
 if(!window.THREE){setStatusMessage('Three.js 3D 라이브러리 연결 실패 · 타겟 모델 로딩 불가');return}
 if(!map.getLayer('tsd-real-size-targets-'+i))target3DLayer(map,i);
}
function redeployMissionTargets(){
 if(pendingDepartureView){targetText('선택 지점의 실제 지면 고도를 확인하는 중입니다');return false;}
 const direct=directControl&&(flight.phase==='off'||flight.phase==='direct');
 const index=direct?selectedIndex():0, map=maps[index];
 if(!map||!terrainOk[index]||!map.getTerrain()||(!direct&&!map.isSourceLoaded('dem'))){
  targetText('지형이 표시된 뒤 표적을 배치하세요');
  return false;
 }
 if(direct&&map.getPitch()>=85){
  targetText('짐벌을 지면 쪽으로 내린 뒤 표적을 배치하세요');
  return false;
 }
 const c=map.getCenter(), bounds=direct?null:map.getBounds(), n=Number($('targetCount').value);
 const canvas=map.getCanvas(), crop=sensorCrop(index);
 const made=[], primary=$('targetKind').value, offset=Math.random()*.45;
 const decoyCount=$('decoyEnabled').checked?Math.ceil(n/2):0;
 const count=n+decoyCount;
 const spreadLat=bounds?Math.min(.018,Math.abs(bounds.getNorth()-bounds.getSouth())*.8):0;
 const spreadLng=bounds?Math.min(.018,Math.abs(bounds.getEast()-bounds.getWest())*.8):0;
 for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
  const angle=2*Math.PI*i/count+offset;
  const ring=.24+.095*(i%3)+Math.random()*.045;
  const {lng,lat}=direct?map.unproject([
   canvas.clientWidth*(.5+Math.cos(angle)*ring/crop),
   canvas.clientHeight*(.5+(.03+Math.sin(angle)*ring*.8)/crop)
  ]):{lat:c.lat+Math.sin(angle)*spreadLat*ring,lng:c.lng+Math.cos(angle)*spreadLng*ring};
  const elevation=direct?directGround(map,{lng,lat}):map.queryTerrainElevation([lng,lat]);
  if(!Number.isFinite(elevation)||!validCoordinates(lng,lat)){
   targetText('표적 위치의 지형을 읽지 못했습니다 · 지도 이동 후 다시 배치하세요');
   return false;
  }
  const decoy=i>=n, kind=decoy&&primary==='fire'?'hotspot':primary;
  const variant=({person:'일반 보행자',vehicle:'일반 차량',hotspot:'고온 장비'})[kind];
  const target={id:i+1,lat,lng,elevation,kind,decoy,variant,found:false,temp:baseTemp(kind,thermalState.env),
    eps:THERMAL[kind].eps,size:[...THERMAL[kind].size]};
  if(kind==='person'){
   target.route=createWalkingRoute(target,i);
   target.speed=decoy?.45:personWalkSpeed;
   target.heading=bearingTo(target.route.points[0],target.route.points[1]);
  }
  if(kind==='fire')target.radius=.8;
  made.push(target);
 }
 const center=direct?map.unproject([canvas.clientWidth/2,canvas.clientHeight/2]):c;
 targetDeploymentArea={
  center:{lng:center.lng,lat:center.lat},
  radius:Math.max(150,...made.map(target=>geoDistance(center,target)+60))
 };
 missionTargets=made;
 targetElapsed=0;
 targetMotionAt=performance.now();
 falseScanCount=0;
 targetMeshVersion++;
 refreshThermalEnvironment(c.lat,c.lng);
 scanCount=0;
 scanAim=null;
 clearMarkers(scanPins);
 supervisorReveal=false;

 maps.forEach(m=>m.triggerRepaint());
 targetText('표적 '+n+'개 배치'+(decoyCount?' · 유사 표적 포함':'')+' · 감독관 위치 비공개');
 return true;
}

function areaCross(a,b,c) {
  return (b.x-a.x)*(c.y-a.y)-(b.y-a.y)*(c.x-a.x);
}
function areaOnEdge(a,b,p) {
  return Math.abs(areaCross(a,b,p))<1e-5 &&
    p.x>=Math.min(a.x,b.x)-1e-6&&p.x<=Math.max(a.x,b.x)+1e-6 &&
    p.y>=Math.min(a.y,b.y)-1e-6&&p.y<=Math.max(a.y,b.y)+1e-6;
}
function areaContains(vertices,p) {
  let inside=false;
  for(let i=0;i<vertices.length;i++){
    const a=vertices[i], b=vertices[(i+1)%vertices.length];
    if(areaOnEdge(a,b,p))return true;
    if((a.y>p.y)!==(b.y>p.y)&&p.x<(b.x-a.x)*(p.y-a.y)/(b.y-a.y)+a.x)inside=!inside;
  }
  return inside;
}
function areaSegmentsIntersect(a,b,c,d) {
  return areaOnEdge(a,b,c)||areaOnEdge(a,b,d)||areaOnEdge(c,d,a)||areaOnEdge(c,d,b)||
    (areaCross(a,b,c)*areaCross(a,b,d)<0&&areaCross(c,d,a)*areaCross(c,d,b)<0);
}
// Split at every boundary intersection so concave cutouts cannot be crossed.
function areaSegmentInside(a,b,vertices) {
  const cuts=[0,1], dx=b.x-a.x,dy=b.y-a.y,d2=dx*dx+dy*dy;
  if(d2<1e-9)return areaContains(vertices,a);
  for(let i=0;i<vertices.length;i++){
    const c=vertices[i],d=vertices[(i+1)%vertices.length];
    const ex=d.x-c.x,ey=d.y-c.y,det=dx*ey-dy*ex;
    if(Math.abs(det)<1e-8){
      for(const p of [c,d])if(areaOnEdge(a,b,p))cuts.push(((p.x-a.x)*dx+(p.y-a.y)*dy)/d2);
      continue;
    }
    const t=((c.x-a.x)*ey-(c.y-a.y)*ex)/det;
    const u=((c.x-a.x)*dy-(c.y-a.y)*dx)/det;
    if(t>0&&t<1&&u>=-1e-8&&u<=1+1e-8)cuts.push(t);
  }
  cuts.sort((x,y)=>x-y);
  return cuts.slice(1).every((t,i)=>{
    const m=(t+cuts[i])/2;
    return areaContains(vertices,{x:a.x+dx*m,y:a.y+dy*m});
  });
}
function areaConnector(start,end,vertices) {
  if(areaSegmentInside(start,end,vertices))return [end];
  const nodes=[start,...vertices,end], last=nodes.length-1;
  const distances=nodes.map(()=>Infinity), previous=nodes.map(()=>-1);
  const remaining=new Set(nodes.map((_,i)=>i));
  distances[0]=0;
  while(remaining.size){
    const i=[...remaining].reduce((best,n)=>distances[n]<distances[best]?n:best);
    if(!Number.isFinite(distances[i])||i===last)break;
    remaining.delete(i);
    const a=nodes[i];
    for(const j of remaining){
      const b=nodes[j], distance=distances[i]+Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y);
      if(distance<distances[j]&&areaSegmentInside(a,b,vertices)){distances[j]=distance;previous[j]=i;}
    }
  }
  if(previous[last]<0)throw Error('구역 안에서 연결 경로를 생성할 수 없습니다');
  const result=[];
  for(let i=last;i>0;i=previous[i])result.unshift(nodes[i]);
  return result;
}
function polygonSweep(vertices,spacing) {
  if(vertices.length<3)throw Error('지도에서 꼭짓점을 3개 이상 지정하세요');
  let area=0;
  for(let i=0;i<vertices.length;i++){
    const a=vertices[i],b=vertices[(i+1)%vertices.length];
    area+=a.x*b.y-b.x*a.y;
    for(let j=i+2;j<vertices.length;j++){
      if(i===0&&j===vertices.length-1)continue;
      if(areaSegmentsIntersect(a,b,vertices[j],vertices[(j+1)%vertices.length]))throw Error('교차한 변이 있습니다 · 꼭짓점을 구역 둘레 순서로 지정하세요');
    }
  }
  if(Math.abs(area)<20)throw Error('구역 면적이 너무 작습니다');
  const south=Math.min(...vertices.map(p=>p.y)),north=Math.max(...vertices.map(p=>p.y));
  const rows=Math.max(1,Math.ceil((north-south)/spacing)), result=[];
  for(let row=0;row<rows;row++){
    const y=south+(row+.5)*(north-south)/rows, intersections=[];
    for(let i=0;i<vertices.length;i++){
      const a=vertices[i],b=vertices[(i+1)%vertices.length];
      if((a.y>y)!==(b.y>y))intersections.push(a.x+(y-a.y)*(b.x-a.x)/(b.y-a.y));
    }
    intersections.sort((a,b)=>row%2?b-a:a-b);
    for(let i=0;i<intersections.length;i+=2){
      const start={x:intersections[i],y},end={x:intersections[i+1],y};
      if(!Number.isFinite(end.x)||Math.abs(end.x-start.x)<.1)continue;
      if(result.length) result.push(...areaConnector(result[result.length-1],start,vertices));
      else result.push(start);
      result.push(end);
    }
  }
  if(result.length<2)throw Error('구역에 유효한 수색 줄을 생성할 수 없습니다');
  return result;
}

const mission = {state:'empty', plan:null, run:null, center:null, poi:null, picking:false, points:[], selected:0};
const missionSource = 'tsd-mission-route';
const missionTypes = {grid:'격자 수색',polygon:'다각형 수색',waypoint:'웨이포인트 비행',line:'직선 수색',orbit:'원형 수색'};
const missionDemZoom=12;
const missionDemCache=new Map();
const missionAircraftMarkers=new WeakMap();
const missionNodeMarkers=new WeakMap();
const draggingMissionMarkers=new WeakSet();
const missionLibraryKey='tsd-eoir-route-library';
const missionLibrary=new Map();

function offsetPoint(center, east, north) {
  return {lng:center.lng+east/(111320*Math.cos(center.lat*degrees)),lat:center.lat+north/111320};
}
function routeDistance(points) {
  return points.slice(1).reduce((total,point,i)=>total+geoDistance(points[i],point),0);
}
function missionDemPixel(point) {
  const scale=256*(2**missionDemZoom), p=maplibregl.MercatorCoordinate.fromLngLat(point);
  return {x:p.x*scale-.5,y:p.y*scale-.5};
}
function missionDemKey(x,y) {return Math.floor(x/256)+'/'+Math.floor(y/256);}
async function loadMissionTile(key) {
  const [x,y]=key.split('/');
  const url=DEM.replace('{z}',missionDemZoom).replace('{x}',x).replace('{y}',y);
  const response=await fetch(url,{signal:AbortSignal.timeout(12000)});
  if(!response.ok)throw Error('DEM '+response.status);
  const bitmap=await createImageBitmap(await response.blob(),{colorSpaceConversion:'none'});
  try {
    if(bitmap.width!==256||bitmap.height!==256)throw Error('DEM size');
    const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width=canvas.height=256;
    const context=canvas.getContext('2d',{willReadFrequently:true});
    context.drawImage(bitmap,0,0);
    return context.getImageData(0,0,256,256).data;
  } finally { bitmap.close(); }
}
async function prepareMissionTerrain(points) {
  const pixels=points.map(missionDemPixel);
  const left=Math.floor(Math.min(...pixels.map(p=>p.x))/256),right=Math.floor((Math.max(...pixels.map(p=>p.x))+1)/256);
  const top=Math.floor(Math.min(...pixels.map(p=>p.y))/256),bottom=Math.floor((Math.max(...pixels.map(p=>p.y))+1)/256);
  if((right-left+1)*(bottom-top+1)>24)throw Error('Mission area');
  const requests=[];
  for(let x=left;x<=right;x++)for(let y=top;y<=bottom;y++){
    const key=x+'/'+y;
    if(!missionDemCache.has(key)){
      if(missionDemCache.size>=48)missionDemCache.delete(missionDemCache.keys().next().value);
      missionDemCache.set(key,loadMissionTile(key).catch(error=>{missionDemCache.delete(key);throw error;}));
    }
    requests.push(missionDemCache.get(key).then(data=>[key,data]));
  }
  return new Map(await Promise.all(requests));
}
function missionGround(point,tiles) {
  const p=missionDemPixel(point), x=Math.floor(p.x),y=Math.floor(p.y), fx=p.x-x,fy=p.y-y;
  const elevation=(px,py)=>{
    const pixels=tiles.get(missionDemKey(px,py));
    if(!pixels)return NaN;
    const i=((py%256)*256+px%256)*4;
    return pixels[i]*256+pixels[i+1]+pixels[i+2]/256-32768;
  };
  const top=elevation(x,y)*(1-fx)+elevation(x+1,y)*fx;
  const bottom=elevation(x,y+1)*(1-fx)+elevation(x+1,y+1)*fx;
  return top*(1-fy)+bottom*fy;
}
function buildMissionPlan(center, options) {
  const {pattern,width,length,spacing,heading}=options;
  const angle=heading*degrees;
  const at=(along,across)=>offsetPoint(center,along*Math.sin(angle)+across*Math.cos(angle),along*Math.cos(angle)-across*Math.sin(angle));
  const points=[];
  if(pattern==='waypoint'){
    if(options.nodes.length<2)throw Error('지도를 클릭해 웨이포인트를 2개 이상 지정하세요');
    points.push(...options.nodes);
  } else if(pattern==='polygon'){
    const eastScale=111320*Math.cos(center.lat*degrees);
    const vertices=options.nodes.map(p=>{
      const east=(p.lng-center.lng)*eastScale,north=(p.lat-center.lat)*111320;
      return {x:east*Math.sin(angle)+north*Math.cos(angle),y:east*Math.cos(angle)-north*Math.sin(angle)};
    });
    points.push(...polygonSweep(vertices,spacing).map(p=>at(p.x,p.y)));
  } else if (pattern==='orbit') {
    for(let i=0;i<=48;i++) {
      const a=i/48*2*Math.PI;
      points.push(at(width*Math.cos(a),width*Math.sin(a)));
    }
  } else if (pattern==='line') {
    if(options.nodes?.length===1)throw Error('직선 수색의 끝점을 지도에서 지정하세요');
    if(options.nodes?.length>=2)points.push(...options.nodes);
    else points.push(at(-length/2,0),at(length/2,0));
  } else {
    const rows=Math.ceil(width/spacing)+1;
    for(let i=0;i<rows;i++) {
      const across=-width/2+i*width/(rows-1), end=i%2===0?length/2:-length/2;
      points.push(at(-end,across),at(end,across));
    }
  }
  return {...options,center,points,distance:routeDistance(points)};
}
function bearingTo(from,to) {
  const east=(to.lng-from.lng)*Math.cos(from.lat*degrees), north=to.lat-from.lat;
  return (Math.atan2(east,north)/degrees+360)%360;
}
function turnToward(target,dt) {
  const delta=headingDelta(flight.yaw,target);
  flight.yaw=(flight.yaw+clamp(delta,-90*dt,90*dt)+360)%360;
}
function headingDelta(from,to,direction) {
  const clockwise=((to-from)%360+360)%360;
  if(direction==='cw'||clockwise===0)return clockwise;
  return direction==='ccw'||clockwise>180?clockwise-360:clockwise;
}
function missionActive() {return mission.state==='running'||mission.state==='paused';}
function missionFlightLabel() {
  if(!missionActive())return '';
  return mission.state==='paused'?'임무 일시정지':{climb:'자동 이륙 · 임무 고도 상승',route:'자동 임무 비행',action:'웨이포인트 카메라 동작',ending:'경로 완료 · 착륙 절차'}[mission.run.phase];
}
function missionFeature(type,geometry,properties={}) {
  return {type:'Feature',geometry:{type,coordinates:geometry},properties};
}
function renderMissionRoute(map) {
  const coords=point=>[point.lng,point.lat];
  const points=mission.plan?.points||[];
  const features=points.length ? [
    missionFeature('LineString',points.map(coords),{kind:'route'}),
    missionFeature('Point',coords(points[0]),{kind:'start'}),
    missionFeature('Point',coords(points[points.length-1]),{kind:'end'})
  ] : [];
  const type=$('searchPattern').value;
  const boundary=type==='polygon'?mission.points:type==='grid'?areaMissionHandles().slice(1):[];
  if(boundary.length>=3){
    const outline=boundary.map(coords);
    outline.push(outline[0]);
    features.push(missionFeature('Polygon',[outline],{kind:'area'}));
  }
  const data={type:'FeatureCollection',features};
  const source=map.getSource(missionSource);
  if(source){source.setData(data);renderMissionNodes(map);return;}
  if(!map.getTerrain())return;
  map.addSource(missionSource,{type:'geojson',data});
  map.addLayer({id:missionSource+'-area',type:'fill',source:missionSource,filter:['==',['get','kind'],'area'],paint:{'fill-color':'#4c95ff','fill-opacity':.17}});
  map.addLayer({id:missionSource+'-border',type:'line',source:missionSource,filter:['==',['get','kind'],'area'],paint:{'line-color':'#8fbdff','line-width':2,'line-dasharray':[2,2]}});
  map.addLayer({id:missionSource+'-line',type:'line',source:missionSource,filter:['==',['get','kind'],'route'],
    layout:{'line-join':'round','line-cap':'round'},paint:{'line-color':'#5eaaff','line-width':3,'line-opacity':.85}});
  map.addLayer({id:missionSource+'-points',type:'circle',source:missionSource,filter:['any',['==',['get','kind'],'start'],['==',['get','kind'],'end']],
    paint:{'circle-radius':4,'circle-color':['match',['get','kind'],'start','#59dcad','#ffc65e'], 'circle-stroke-width':2,'circle-stroke-color':'#193664'}});
  renderMissionNodes(map);
}
function missionCanEdit() {
  return !$('missionPanel').hidden&&!missionActive()&&mission.state!=='preparing';
}
function editMissionPoint(index, point, insert=false) {
  if(!validCoordinates(point.lng,point.lat)||mission.points.some((p,i)=>(insert||i!==index)&&geoDistance(p,point)<1)){
    $('missionPlanState').value='경로점은 다른 지점과 1 m 이상 떨어져야 합니다';
    maps.forEach(renderMissionNodes);return;
  }
  const rebuild=Boolean(mission.plan), coords={lng:point.lng,lat:point.lat};
  if(insert)mission.points.splice(index,0,coords);
  else Object.assign(mission.points[index],coords);
  mission.selected=index;
  invalidateMissionPlan();refreshMissionEditor();
  if(rebuild)prepareMission(false);
}
function areaMissionHandles() {
  const {plan}=mission;
  if(!plan)return [];
  if(plan.pattern==='orbit')return [{...plan.center,label:'C'},{...plan.points[0],label:'R'}];
  if(plan.pattern!=='grid')return [];
  const a=plan.heading*degrees, x=plan.length/2,y=plan.width/2;
  return [{...plan.center,label:'C'},...[[x,y],[-x,y],[-x,-y],[x,-y]].map(([along,across],i)=>({
    ...offsetPoint(plan.center,along*Math.sin(a)+across*Math.cos(a),along*Math.cos(a)-across*Math.sin(a)),label:String(i+1)
  }))];
}
function dragAreaHandle(index,point) {
  const {plan}=mission;
  if(!validCoordinates(point.lng,point.lat)){maps.forEach(renderMissionNodes);return;}
  if(index===0)mission.center={lng:point.lng,lat:point.lat};
  else if(plan.pattern==='orbit'){
    $('missionWidth').value=Math.round(clamp(geoDistance(plan.center,point),40,700));
    $('missionHeading').value=Math.round(bearingTo(plan.center,point))%360;
  } else {
    const a=plan.heading*degrees;
    const east=(point.lng-plan.center.lng)*111320*Math.cos(plan.center.lat*degrees), north=(point.lat-plan.center.lat)*111320;
    $('missionLength').value=Math.round(clamp(2*Math.abs(east*Math.sin(a)+north*Math.cos(a)),40,700));
    $('missionWidth').value=Math.round(clamp(2*Math.abs(east*Math.cos(a)-north*Math.sin(a)),40,700));
  }
  invalidateMissionPlan();prepareMission(false);
}
function renderMissionNodes(map) {
  (missionNodeMarkers.get(map)||[]).forEach(marker=>marker.remove());
  const editable=missionCanEdit(), type=$('searchPattern').value;
  const area=type==='grid'||type==='orbit';
  const nodes=area?(editable?areaMissionHandles():[]):mission.points;
  const markers=nodes.map((node,index)=>{
    const element=document.createElement(editable?'button':'div');
    element.className='missionNode'+(!area&&index===mission.selected?' selected':'');
    element.textContent=node.label??(index===0&&(type==='waypoint'||type==='line')?'S':String(index+1));
    const marker=new maplibregl.Marker({element,draggable:editable}).setLngLat(node).addTo(map);
    if(editable){
      element.type='button';element.setAttribute('aria-label',(area?'구역 조절점 ':'경로점 ')+element.textContent);
      element.onclick=e=>{
        e.stopPropagation();
        if(area||!missionCanEdit())return;
        mission.selected=index;refreshMissionEditor();
        maps.forEach(m=>(missionNodeMarkers.get(m)||[]).forEach((item,i)=>item.getElement().classList.toggle('selected',i===index)));
      };
      marker.on('dragstart',()=>draggingMissionMarkers.add(marker));
      marker.on('dragend',()=>{
        draggingMissionMarkers.delete(marker);
        if(missionCanEdit())(area?dragAreaHandle:editMissionPoint)(index,marker.getLngLat());
      });
    } else element.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
    return marker;
  });
  if(editable&&!area&&nodes.length<24){
    const count=type==='polygon'&&nodes.length>2?nodes.length:nodes.length-1;
    for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
      const a=nodes[i],b=nodes[(i+1)%nodes.length];
      if(geoDistance(a,b)<2)continue;
      const mid={lng:(a.lng+b.lng)/2,lat:(a.lat+b.lat)/2};
      const button=document.createElement('button');
      button.type='button';button.className='missionInsert';button.textContent='+';
      button.setAttribute('aria-label',(i+1)+'번과 '+((i+1)%nodes.length+1)+'번 사이 경로점 추가');
      button.onclick=e=>{e.stopPropagation();if(missionCanEdit())editMissionPoint(i+1,mid,true);};
      markers.push(new maplibregl.Marker({element:button}).setLngLat(mid).addTo(map));
    }
  }
  if(mission.poi){
    const element=document.createElement('span');
    element.className='missionPoiMarker';element.textContent='POI';
    const marker=new maplibregl.Marker({element,draggable:editable}).setLngLat(mission.poi).addTo(map);
    marker.on('dragstart',()=>draggingMissionMarkers.add(marker));
    marker.on('dragend',()=>{draggingMissionMarkers.delete(marker);if(missionCanEdit())setMissionPoi(marker.getLngLat());});
    markers.push(marker);
  }
  missionNodeMarkers.set(map,markers);
  if(!markers.length)return;
  const refreshPositions=()=>{
    if(missionNodeMarkers.get(map)!==markers)return;
    for(const marker of markers){
      if(!draggingMissionMarkers.has(marker))marker.setLngLat(marker.getLngLat());
    }
  };
  // Terrain elevation used for marker projection can change when the next tiles render.
  map.once('render',refreshPositions);
  map.once('idle',refreshPositions);
}
function updateMissionAircraft() {
  for(const map of maps){
    let marker=missionAircraftMarkers.get(map);
    if(!missionActive()||!flight.point){
      marker?.remove();missionAircraftMarkers.delete(map);continue;
    }
    if(!marker){
      const element=document.createElement('div');
      element.className='missionAircraft';
      element.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
      marker=new maplibregl.Marker({element,rotationAlignment:'map'}).setLngLat(flight.point).addTo(map);
      missionAircraftMarkers.set(map,marker);
    }
    marker.setLngLat(flight.point).setRotation(flight.yaw);
  }
}
function setMissionPanel(visible) {
  $('missionPanel').hidden=!visible;
  $('missionOpen').setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(visible));
  if(!visible){cancelMissionPick();$('missionPreflight').hidden=true;$('missionConfirm').disabled=true;}
  if(visible&&flight.phase==='off'&&maps[selectedIndex()]?.getPitch()>65){
    const map=maps[selectedIndex()], point=groundLaunchPoint(map);
    jumpBoth({center:[point.lng,point.lat],pitch:0,zoom:map.getZoom(),bearing:map.getBearing()});
  }
  maps.forEach(renderMissionNodes);
}
function cancelMissionPick() {
  mission.picking=false;
  $('missionPick').setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');
  $('missionPoi').setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');
  $('stage').classList.remove('pickingMission');
}
const waypointFields={waypointHeight:'height',waypointSpeed:'speed',waypointYaw:'yaw',waypointGimbal:'tilt',waypointZoom:'zoom',waypointHold:'hold',waypointCamera:'camera',waypointPhoto:'photo',waypointHeadingMode:'headingMode',waypointRotation:'rotation',waypointPitchMode:'pitchMode'};
const pointPattern=type=>type==='polygon'||type==='waypoint'||type==='line';
function refreshMissionEditor() {
  const type=$('searchPattern').value, point=mission.points[mission.selected];
  const locked=missionActive()||mission.state==='preparing';
  const select=$('missionPoint');
  $('missionEditor').hidden=!pointPattern(type);
  $('missionReverse').hidden=type!=='line'&&type!=='waypoint';
  $('missionReverse').disabled=locked||mission.points.length<2;
  $('waypointActions').hidden=type!=='waypoint'||!point;
  $('waypointSegment').hidden=type!=='waypoint'||mission.selected>=mission.points.length-1;
  $('waypointSegmentLabel').value=`WP ${mission.selected+1} → WP ${mission.selected+2}`;
  $('waypointRotationLabel').hidden=(point?.headingMode||$('missionYawMode').value)!=='smooth';
  $('missionPointPrev').disabled=locked||!point||mission.selected===0;
  $('missionPointNext').disabled=locked||!point||mission.selected>=mission.points.length-1;
  $('missionClearPoi').hidden=!mission.poi;
  $('missionYawLabel').hidden=$('missionYawMode').value!=='fixed';
  $('missionTiltLabel').hidden=$('missionGimbalMode').value!=='fixed';
  select.replaceChildren(...(mission.points.length?mission.points.map((_,i)=>new Option((type==='polygon'?'꼭짓점 ':'WP ')+(i+1),i)):[new Option('지점 없음','')]));
  if(point)select.value=String(mission.selected);
  for(const id of ['missionPoint','missionMovePoint','missionDeletePoint','missionClearPoints'])$(id).disabled=locked||!point;
  for(const [id,key] of Object.entries(waypointFields)){
    const field=$(id);
    field.disabled=locked||!point;
    if(!point)continue;
    if(key==='photo')field.checked=Boolean(point[key]);
    else field.value=point[key]??(key==='hold'?0:'');
  }
}
function setMissionPoi(point) {
  const rebuild=Boolean(mission.plan);
  mission.poi=point&&validCoordinates(point.lng,point.lat)?{lng:point.lng,lat:point.lat}:null;
  invalidateMissionPlan();refreshMissionEditor();
  if(rebuild)prepareMission(false);
}
function beginMissionPick(mode) {
  mission.picking=mode;
  $('missionPick').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(mode==='add'));
  $('missionPoi').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(mode==='poi'));
  $('stage').classList.add('pickingMission');
  const type=$('searchPattern').value;
  $('missionPlanState').value=mode==='poi'?'지도에서 관심 지점을 클릭하세요':mode==='move'?'지도에서 이 지점의 새 위치를 클릭하세요':type==='polygon'?'구역 둘레를 따라 꼭짓점을 차례로 클릭하세요':type==='waypoint'?'비행 순서대로 지도에서 웨이포인트를 클릭하세요':type==='line'?'지도에서 시작점과 끝점을 순서대로 클릭하세요':'EO 또는 IR 지도에서 수색 중심을 클릭하세요';
}
function pickMissionCenter(point) {
  if(!mission.picking)return false;
  if(!validCoordinates(point.lng,point.lat))return true;
  const coords={lng:point.lng,lat:point.lat}, type=$('searchPattern').value;
  if(mission.picking==='poi'){
    cancelMissionPick();setMissionPoi(coords);
    if(!mission.plan)$('missionPlanState').value='관심 지점 지정 · 기체 방향에서 선택하세요';
    return true;
  }
  if(pointPattern(type)){
    if(mission.picking==='add'&&mission.points.length>=24){$('missionPlanState').value='지점은 최대 24개입니다';cancelMissionPick();return true;}
    if(mission.points.some((p,i)=>(mission.picking!=='move'||i!==mission.selected)&&geoDistance(p,coords)<1)){
      $('missionPlanState').value='이미 지정한 지점입니다 · 다른 지점을 클릭하세요';return true;
    }
    if(mission.picking==='move'){
      cancelMissionPick();
      editMissionPoint(mission.selected,coords);
      return true;
    } else {
      mission.points.push(coords);
      mission.selected=mission.points.length-1;
      if(type==='line'&&mission.points.length===2)cancelMissionPick();
    }
    invalidateMissionPlan();
    updateMissionFields();
    $('missionPlanState').value=type==='line'&&mission.points.length===1?'시작점 지정 · 끝점을 클릭하세요':mission.points.length+'개 지정 · '+(type==='polygon'?'3개 이상에서 경로 미리보기':'2개 이상에서 경로 미리보기');
  } else {
    mission.center=coords;
    invalidateMissionPlan();
    $('missionPlanState').value='중심 지정 · '+point.lat.toFixed(5)+', '+point.lng.toFixed(5);
    cancelMissionPick();
  }
  return true;
}
function updateMissionFields() {
  const pattern=$('searchPattern').value;
  for(const id of ['missionYawMode','missionGimbalMode']){
    const menu=$(id);
    menu.querySelector('option[value="smooth"]').hidden=pattern!=='waypoint';
    if(pattern!=='waypoint'&&menu.value==='smooth')menu.selectedIndex=0;
  }
  $('missionWidthLabel').hidden=pattern!=='grid'&&pattern!=='orbit';
  $('missionWidthLabel').firstElementChild.textContent=pattern==='orbit'?'반경':'폭';
  $('missionLengthLabel').hidden=pattern!=='grid'&&(pattern!=='line'||mission.points.length>0);
  $('missionSpacingLabel').hidden=pattern!=='grid'&&pattern!=='polygon';
  $('missionHeadingLabel').hidden=pattern==='waypoint'||pattern==='line'&&mission.points.length>0;
  $('missionPick').textContent=pattern==='polygon'?'지도에서 꼭짓점 추가':pattern==='waypoint'?'지도에서 웨이포인트 추가':pattern==='line'?'지도에서 시작점·끝점 지정':'지도에서 중심 지정';
  refreshMissionEditor();
}
const missionFields=['missionHeight','missionSpeed','missionWidth','missionLength','missionSpacing','missionHeading','missionEnd','searchPattern','missionYawMode','missionYaw','missionGimbalMode','missionTilt','missionAltitudeMode','missionTakeoffHeight'];
function updateMissionUI() {
  const active=missionActive(), paused=mission.state==='paused', preparing=mission.state==='preparing';
  $('missionStop').disabled=!active||Boolean(flight.assisted);
  $('missionStop').hidden=!active||Boolean(flight.assisted);
  $('missionEndFlight').hidden=!active||Boolean(flight.assisted);
  $('missionStop').textContent=paused?'재개':'일시정지';
  $('missionRun').disabled=!(mission.state==='ready'||paused);
  $('missionRun').textContent=paused?'임무 재개':'비행 전 점검';
  if(mission.state!=='ready')$('missionPreflight').hidden=true;
  $('missionCancel').disabled=!active&&!preparing;
  $('missionPreview').disabled=active||preparing;
  $('missionPick').disabled=active||preparing;
  $('missionSaved').disabled=active||preparing;
  $('missionSave').disabled=mission.state!=='ready';
  for(const field of missionFields)$(field).disabled=active||preparing;
  $('missionPoi').disabled=$('missionClearPoi').disabled=active||preparing;
  const pointLocked=active||preparing||!mission.points.length;
  for(const id of ['missionPoint','missionMovePoint','missionDeletePoint','missionClearPoints',...Object.keys(waypointFields)])$(id).disabled=pointLocked;
  $('missionReverse').disabled=pointLocked||mission.points.length<2;
  $('missionHud').hidden=!mission.run||preparing;
  if(mission.run){
    const run=mission.run;
    const progress=mission.state==='completed'?1:clamp(run.travelled/mission.plan.distance,0,1);
    $('missionProgressBar').value=progress;
    const phase=missionFlightLabel() || (mission.state==='completed'?'임무 완료':'임무 종료');
    $('missionProgress').value=phase+' · '+Math.round(progress*100)+'% · '+Math.round(run.travelled)+' / '+Math.round(mission.plan.distance)+' m';
  }
  updateFlightUI();
}
function refreshMissionLibrary(selected='') {
  const menu=$('missionSaved');
  menu.replaceChildren(new Option('저장 경로',''),...[...missionLibrary.keys()].map(name=>new Option(name,name)));
  menu.value=selected;
}
function saveMissionPlan() {
  if(mission.state!=='ready')return;
  const input=$('missionName'), name=input.value.trim();
  if(!name){$('missionPlanState').value='저장할 경로 이름을 입력하세요';input.focus();return;}
  const {points,distance,...settings}=mission.plan;
  const next=new Map(missionLibrary).set(name,settings);
  try {localStorage.setItem(missionLibraryKey,JSON.stringify([...next]));}
  catch {$('missionPlanState').value='이 브라우저에 경로를 저장하지 못했습니다';return;}
  missionLibrary.set(name,settings);
  refreshMissionLibrary(name);
  $('missionPlanState').value='경로 저장 완료 · '+name;
}
function loadMissionPlan() {
  const name=$('missionSaved').value, saved=missionLibrary.get(name);
  if(!saved||missionActive()||mission.state==='preparing')return;
  mission.center=saved.center;
  mission.poi=validCoordinates(saved.poi?.lng,saved.poi?.lat)?saved.poi:null;
  $('missionYawMode').value=saved.yawMode??'auto';$('missionYaw').value=saved.yaw??0;
  $('missionGimbalMode').value=saved.gimbalMode??'keep';$('missionTilt').value=saved.tilt??-45;
  $('missionAltitudeMode').value=saved.altitudeMode??'agl';$('missionTakeoffHeight').value=saved.takeoffHeight??0;
  mission.points=(Array.isArray(saved.nodes)?saved.nodes:[]).filter(p=>validCoordinates(p?.lng,p?.lat)).slice(0,24).map(p=>({...p}));
  mission.selected=0;
  $('missionName').value=name;
  for(const [field,value] of Object.entries(saved)) {
    if(field==='center')continue;
    const id=({pattern:'searchPattern',height:'missionHeight',speed:'missionSpeed',width:'missionWidth',length:'missionLength',spacing:'missionSpacing',heading:'missionHeading',end:'missionEnd'})[field];
    if(id)$(id).value=value;
  }
  updateMissionFields();
  invalidateMissionPlan();
  prepareMission();
}
function clearMission() {
  Object.assign(mission,{state:'empty',plan:null,run:null,center:null,poi:null,points:[],selected:0});
  cancelMissionPick();
  $('missionStats').value='경로 미생성';
  $('missionPlanState').value='지도에서 수색 중심을 잡으세요';
  maps.forEach(renderMissionRoute);
  updateMissionAircraft();
  refreshMissionEditor();
  updateMissionUI();
}
function invalidateMissionPlan() {
  if(missionActive()||mission.state==='preparing')return;
  mission.plan=null;mission.run=null;mission.state='empty';
  $('missionStats').value='경로 미생성';
  $('missionPlanState').value='설정 확인 후 경로를 생성하세요';
  maps.forEach(renderMissionRoute);
  updateMissionUI();
}
function prepareMission(fit=true) {
  if(missionActive()||mission.state==='preparing')return;
  const map=maps[selectedIndex()];
  if(!map || !terrainOk[selectedIndex()]){ $('missionPlanState').value='3D 지형이 연결된 뒤 경로를 준비할 수 있습니다';return; }
  if($('searchPattern').value==='waypoint'&&!$('waypointActions').hidden){
    const invalid=Object.keys(waypointFields).map($).find(field=>!field.validity.valid);
    if(invalid){invalid.reportValidity();return;}
  }
  const inputs=missionFields.map($).filter(field=>field.type==='number'&&!field.parentElement.hidden);
  if(inputs.some(field=>field.value===''||!field.validity.valid)){
    inputs.find(field=>field.value===''||!field.validity.valid).reportValidity();
    $('missionPlanState').value='허용 범위의 숫자를 입력하세요';return;
  }
  const pattern=$('searchPattern').value, nodes=mission.points.map(point=>({...point}));
  let center=mission.center||map.getCenter();
  if(pointPattern(pattern)&&nodes.length){
    center={lng:nodes.reduce((s,p)=>s+p.lng,0)/nodes.length,lat:nodes.reduce((s,p)=>s+p.lat,0)/nodes.length};
    if(nodes.some(p=>geoDistance(center,p)>1200)){$('missionPlanState').value='경로는 중심에서 1.2 km 이내로 지정하세요';return;}
  }
  let plan;
  try {
    plan=buildMissionPlan({lng:center.lng,lat:center.lat},{pattern,nodes,
      height:Number($('missionHeight').value),speed:Number($('missionSpeed').value),width:Number($('missionWidth').value),
      length:Number($('missionLength').value),spacing:Number($('missionSpacing').value),heading:Number($('missionHeading').value),end:$('missionEnd').value,
      yawMode:$('missionYawMode').value,yaw:Number($('missionYaw').value),gimbalMode:$('missionGimbalMode').value,tilt:Number($('missionTilt').value),poi:mission.poi,
      altitudeMode:$('missionAltitudeMode').value,takeoffHeight:Number($('missionTakeoffHeight').value)});
  } catch(error) {$('missionPlanState').value=error.message;return;}
  if(plan.distance<1||!plan.points.every(point=>validCoordinates(point.lng,point.lat))){$('missionPlanState').value='경로 길이와 지도 범위를 확인하세요';return;}
  if(!plan.poi&&(plan.yawMode==='poi'||(pattern==='waypoint'&&nodes.slice(0,-1).some(p=>p.headingMode==='poi')))){
    $('missionPlanState').value='관심 지점 보기에는 지도에서 POI를 지정해야 합니다';return;
  }
  mission.plan=plan;mission.run=null;mission.state='ready';
  $('missionPreflight').hidden=true;
  cancelMissionPick();
  const seconds=pattern==='waypoint'?nodes.reduce((sum,p,i)=>sum+(p.hold||0)+(i?geoDistance(nodes[i-1],p)/(p.speed??plan.speed):0),0):plan.distance/plan.speed;
  $('missionStats').value=missionTypes[plan.pattern]+' · '+Math.round(plan.distance)+' m · 경로 약 '+Math.ceil(seconds)+'초';
  $('missionPlanState').value='경로 준비 · 지도에서 확인하세요';
  if(pattern==='line'&&!nodes.length){mission.points=plan.points.map(p=>({...p}));updateMissionFields();}
  if(fit&&flight.phase==='off'){
    const scale=2*Math.max(...plan.points.map(point=>geoDistance(center,point)),20);
    const pixels=Math.max(70,Math.min(map.getCanvas().clientWidth,map.getCanvas().clientHeight)-80);
    const zoom=clamp(Math.log2(40075017*Math.cos(center.lat*degrees)*pixels/(512*(scale+80)*1.4)),10,18);
    routePreviewLaunch=groundLaunchPoint(map);
    jumpBoth({center,zoom,pitch:0,bearing:map.getBearing()});
  }
  maps.forEach(renderMissionRoute);
  updateMissionUI();
}
function showMissionPreflight() {
  if(mission.state==='paused'){resumeMission();return;}
  if(mission.state!=='ready')return;
  const {pattern,height,speed,end,altitudeMode,takeoffHeight}=mission.plan;
  $('missionPreflightInfo').value=missionTypes[pattern]+' · '+(altitudeMode==='takeoff'?'ALT ':'AGL ')+height+' m · '+speed+' m/s · '+({home:'홈 복귀·착륙',land:'마지막 지점 착륙',hover:'제자리 대기'}[end])+(flight.phase!=='air'&&takeoffHeight?' · 이륙 상승 '+takeoffHeight+' m':'');
  $('missionPreflight').hidden=false;
  $('missionConfirm').disabled=true;
  $('missionUpload').disabled=false;
  $('missionUpload').focus();
}
async function startMission() {
  if(mission.state==='paused'){resumeMission();return;}
  if(mission.state!=='ready')return;
  if(flight.assisted){$('missionPlanState').value='현재 이륙·복귀·착륙이 끝난 뒤 시작하세요';return;}
  const map=maps[selectedIndex()];
  if(!map||!terrainOk[selectedIndex()]){ $('missionPlanState').value='3D 지형 연결 후 실행하세요';return; }
  const plan=mission.plan, start=flight.point||groundLaunchPoint(map), home=flight.home||start;
  if(!validCoordinates(start.lng,start.lat)){ $('missionPlanState').value='이륙 위치를 국내 지도 범위 안에서 선택하세요';return; }
  if([start,home].some(point=>geoDistance(point,plan.center)>1500)){$('missionPlanState').value='기체와 출발점이 경로 중심에서 1.5 km 이내여야 합니다';return;}
  const run={phase:'climb',groundLaunch:flight.phase!=='air'&&flight.phase!=='direct',home:{lng:home.lng,lat:home.lat},index:0,travelled:0,lastPose:0,tiles:null,leg:null,tilt:null};
  mission.run=run;
  mission.state='preparing';
  $('missionPlanState').value='경로와 출발점의 지형 고도 확인 중';
  updateMissionUI();
  try {run.tiles=await prepareMissionTerrain([start,home,...plan.points]);}
  catch {
    if(mission.state!=='preparing'||mission.run!==run)return;
    mission.run=null;mission.state='ready';
    $('missionPlanState').value='경로의 DEM을 불러오지 못했습니다 · 다시 실행하세요';
    updateMissionUI();return;
  }
  if(mission.state!=='preparing'||mission.run!==run)return;
  if(!terrainOk[selectedIndex()]) {
    mission.run=null;mission.state='ready';
    $('missionPlanState').value='지도 전환 완료 후 다시 실행하세요';
    updateMissionUI();return;
  }
  const ground=missionGround(start,run.tiles);
  run.takeoffGround=flight.takeoffGround??ground;
  if(!Number.isFinite(ground)||!Number.isFinite(run.takeoffGround)){
    mission.run=null;mission.state='ready';
    $('missionPlanState').value='이륙 지점의 고도를 확인하지 못했습니다';updateMissionUI();return;
  }
  const newHome=!flight.home;
  const airborne=flight.phase==='air'||(flight.phase==='direct'&&Number.isFinite(flight.alt)&&flight.alt>ground+2);
  run.groundLaunch=!airborne;
  if(!airborne)Object.assign(flight,{phase:'air',point:{lng:start.lng,lat:start.lat},home:run.home,takeoffGround:run.takeoffGround,ground,alt:ground,yaw:map.getBearing(),vs:0,speed:0});
  else {flight.phase='air';flight.home=run.home;flight.takeoffGround=run.takeoffGround;run.phase='route';}
  directControl=false;
  flight.ground=ground;
  mission.state='running';
  $('missionPlanState').value='임무 실행 중';
  setStatusMessage('가상 기체가 수색 경로로 이동합니다');
  announceFlight(newHome?'홈 포인트가 기록되었습니다. 임무를 시작합니다.':'임무를 시작합니다.');
  setMissionPanel(false);
  routePreviewLaunch=null;
  maps.forEach(map=>browsedLaunchMaps.delete(map));
  recenterAssistMap();
  updateMissionUI();
}
function pauseMission(message='임무 일시정지 · 현재 위치 유지') {
  if(mission.state!=='running')return;
  tsdStopInterval('임무 일시정지');
  mission.state='paused';
  flight.vs=0;flight.speed=0;
  setStatusMessage(message);
  announceFlight('임무를 일시 정지합니다.');
  $('missionPlanState').value=message;
  updateMissionUI();
}
function resumeMission() {
  if(mission.state!=='paused'||!terrainOk[selectedIndex()])return;
  mission.state='running';
  setStatusMessage('자동 임무 재개');
  announceFlight('임무를 재개합니다.');
  $('missionPlanState').value='임무 실행 중';
  updateMissionUI();
}
function finishMission(state, message) {
  tsdStopInterval('임무 종료');
  mission.state=state;
  flight.vs=0;flight.speed=0;
  attitudeVelocity={forward:0,right:0};
  $('missionPlanState').value=message;
  setStatusMessage(message);
  announceFlight(state==='completed'?'임무가 완료되었습니다.':'임무를 종료합니다.');
  updateMissionAircraft();
  updateMissionUI();
}
function cancelMission() {
  if(mission.state==='preparing'){
    tsdStopInterval('임무 준비 취소');
    mission.run=null;mission.state='ready';
    $('missionPlanState').value='임무 실행 준비 취소';
    updateMissionUI();return;
  }
  if(!missionActive())return;
  if(flight.assisted?.missionEnd)flight.assisted=null;
  finishMission('cancelled','임무 종료 · 제자리 대기 · RTH 또는 착륙 선택');
}
function missionAltitude(target,dt,rate) {
  const delta=clamp(target-flight.alt,-rate*dt,rate*dt);
  flight.alt+=delta;
  flight.vs=delta/dt;
}
function missionLegPose(from, destination, progress, dt) {
  const {plan,run}=mission;
  if(run.phase!=='route'){
    run.tilt=null;
    if(geoDistance(from,destination)>.03)turnToward(flight.course,dt);
    return;
  }
  const previous=plan.pattern==='waypoint'?plan.points[run.index-1]:null;
  const headingMode=previous?.headingMode||plan.yawMode;
  const pitchMode=previous?.pitchMode||plan.gimbalMode;
  const leg=run.leg;
  const originYaw=previous?.yaw??leg.yaw;
  if(headingMode==='smooth'){
    const delta=headingDelta(originYaw,destination.yaw??originYaw,previous?.rotation);
    flight.yaw=(originYaw+delta*progress+360)%360;
  } else if(headingMode==='fixed'){
    turnToward(previous?.headingMode==='fixed'?originYaw:plan.yaw,dt);
  } else {
    const look=headingMode==='poi'?plan.poi:headingMode!=='course'&&plan.pattern==='orbit'&&run.index>0?plan.center:destination;
    if(look&&geoDistance(from,look)>.03)turnToward(bearingTo(from,look),dt);
  }
  if(pitchMode==='smooth'){
    const start=previous?.tilt??leg.tilt, end=destination.tilt??start;
    run.tilt=start+(end-start)*progress;
  } else if(pitchMode==='fixed')run.tilt=previous?.pitchMode==='fixed'?(previous.tilt??leg.tilt):plan.tilt;
  else run.tilt=previous?.pitchMode==='keep'?leg.tilt:null;
}
function missionMotion(destination,dt) {
  const from=flight.point, remaining=geoDistance(from,destination);
  const distance=Math.min(remaining,(destination.speed??mission.plan.speed)*dt);
  const fraction=remaining>0?distance/remaining:1;
  const point=distance>=remaining?{lng:destination.lng,lat:destination.lat}:{lng:from.lng+(destination.lng-from.lng)*fraction,lat:from.lat+(destination.lat-from.lat)*fraction};
  const run=mission.run;
  if(run.leg?.destination!==destination)run.leg={destination,length:remaining,yaw:flight.yaw,tilt:maps[selectedIndex()].getPitch()-90};
  const ground=missionGround(point,mission.run.tiles);
  if(!Number.isFinite(ground)){
    pauseMission('지형 고도 확인 대기 · 지도 로딩 후 재개하세요');
    return false;
  }
  const defaultHeight=mission.plan.height;
  const previous=run.phase==='route'&&mission.plan.pattern==='waypoint'?mission.plan.points[run.index-1]:null;
  const progress=run.leg.length>0?clamp(1-(remaining-distance)/run.leg.length,0,1):1;
  const endHeight=destination.height??defaultHeight, startHeight=previous?.height??defaultHeight;
  const height=previous?startHeight+(endHeight-startHeight)*progress:endHeight;
  const target=(mission.plan.altitudeMode==='takeoff'?run.takeoffGround:ground)+height;
  if(target<ground+1){pauseMission('경로 고도가 지형과 충돌합니다 · 임무 일시정지');return false;}
  missionAltitude(target,dt,5);
  if(flight.alt+1<target){flight.speed=0;return false;}
  flight.ground=ground;
  if(remaining>.03)flight.course=bearingTo(from,destination);

  flight.speed=distance/dt;
  if(mission.run.phase==='route'&&mission.run.index>0)mission.run.travelled+=distance;

  return distance>=remaining&&heightReached;
}
function nextMissionPoint() {
  const {plan,run}=mission;
  if(++run.index<plan.points.length){run.phase='route';return;}
  run.travelled=plan.distance;
  if(plan.end==='home'||plan.end==='land'){
    const altitude=$('rthAltitude');
    if(plan.end==='home'&&(!altitude.validity.valid||altitude.value==='')){
      finishMission('completed','경로 완료 · RTH 고도 설정 필요 · 제자리 대기');return;
    }
    tsdStopInterval('경로 촬영 종료');
    run.phase='ending';
    assistFlight(plan.end==='home'?'return':'land',true);
    updateMissionUI();
  }else finishMission('completed','임무 완료 · 현재 위치 대기');
}
function applyWaypointCamera(point) {
  const map=maps[selectedIndex()];
  const tilt=point.tilt??mission.run.tilt??map.getPitch()-90;
  if(point.zoom!=null){
    for(const index of (linked()?[0,1]:[selectedIndex()]))setSensorMagnification(index,point.zoom);
    updateZoomUI();
  }
  aircraftCamera({tilt});
  mission.run.tilt=null;
}
function advanceWaypointAction(dt) {
  const run=mission.run, point=mission.plan.points[run.index];
  flight.vs=0;flight.speed=0;
  if(point.yaw!=null){
    turnToward(point.yaw,dt);
    if(Math.abs((point.yaw-flight.yaw+540)%360-180)>.1)return;
  }
  if(!run.actionApplied){
    // The newly visible single-view canvas must have its final dimensions first.
    if(!run.cameraReady){if(point.camera)selectCamera(point.camera);run.cameraReady=true;return;}
    applyWaypointCamera(point);
    run.actionApplied=true;
    if(point.photo)run.photoResult=takePhoto();
  }
  run.actionRemaining=Math.max(0,run.actionRemaining-dt);
  if(run.photoResult==='busy')run.photoResult=takePhoto();
  if(run.photoResult==='busy'||run.photoResult==='pending'&&photoPending)return;
  if(run.actionRemaining<=0)nextMissionPoint();
}
function advanceMission(dt, now, render=true) {
  if(mission.state!=='running'||document.hidden||dt<=0)return;
  const {plan,run}=mission, map=maps[selectedIndex()];
  if(!map||!terrainOk[selectedIndex()]){pauseMission('지형 연결 대기 · 임무 일시정지');return;}
  if(run.phase==='climb') {
    const climb=plan.takeoffHeight||plan.height;
    missionAltitude(flight.ground+climb,dt,5);
    if(plan.gimbalMode==='fixed')run.tilt=plan.tilt;
    if(Math.abs(flight.alt-flight.ground-climb)<.01)run.phase='route';
  } else if(run.phase==='route') {
    const point=plan.points[run.index];
    if(missionMotion(point,dt)){
      if(plan.pattern==='waypoint'){
        run.phase='action';run.actionRemaining=point.hold||0;run.actionApplied=false;run.cameraReady=false;run.photoResult=null;
      } else nextMissionPoint();
    }
  } else if(run.phase==='action') {
    advanceWaypointAction(dt);
  }
  if((render&&now-run.lastPose>=65)||mission.state==='completed'){
    run.lastPose=now;
    aircraftCamera({tilt:run.tilt});
    if(missionActive())updateMissionAircraft();
    updateMissionUI();
  }
}
function restoreMissionLibrary(raw) {
  let entries;
  try { entries=JSON.parse(raw||'[]'); } catch { return 0; }
  if(!Array.isArray(entries))return 0;
  let restored=0;
  for(const entry of entries){
    if(!Array.isArray(entry)||entry.length!==2)continue;
    const [name,saved]=entry;
    if(typeof name!=='string'||!name.trim()||!saved||!Object.hasOwn(missionTypes,saved.pattern)||!validCoordinates(saved.center?.lng,saved.center?.lat))continue;
    missionLibrary.set(name,saved);restored++;
  }
  return restored;
}
